Working as the apartment security, he had to put up with all sorts of abuse from its residents. One day, he comes across their secrets, and now the tables are turned!

"You like spreading your legs in front of a loser?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

150068.description:
Countess Edwith was destined to be executed for stealing Prince Linus' magical heart and selling it. That is, before I became the villainess herself! To avoid getting killed, I set off to search for the heart's whereabouts, only to end up stumbling upon a half-dead Linus! Getting involved with the heartless male lead is the last thing I want, but what can a girl do when her survival depends on it? Besides, it shouldn't be that hard to convince Linus that I'm not as evil as he thinks... right?

(Source: Tapas)

悪女なのに男主人公を拾ってしまった

150069.description:
I got caught jerking off while looking at my brother's hot wife.

"Sis, can I please, just touch it once?"

But to my surprise, she came on to me instead! Just what is going on?!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

150070.description: Waking up in a strange world filled with imitations that somehow look human, a samurai with no memory is searching for his real form.

150071.description:
Jung-Woo goes to this particular study room for one reason: Because of the hot lady who runs it! But his harem is just beginning…

After Du Sichen, originally a normal college student, wakes from a dream of getting smacked in the face with a meteor and being pushed down by a man, his life encounters enormous changes--

150076.description:
Eloise Wayana, the grand duchess of the North, is executed by Emperor Caien Helisis after it is revealed that she was secretly a villainess all along. This marks the end of season two of the latest trending web novel, “The Crown of Blood.” As one of its avid readers, Kim Dakyung is eagerly waiting for the next season when she is suddenly hit by a truck on her way home! But once she reawakens, she finds that she is in the body of the grand duchess herself and has been teleported back to the novel’s beginning. Already knowing what road Eloise will go down, Dakyung is desperate to change her fate and survive until season three. Lucky for her, a younger version of Caien falls right into her hands, and she is going to do whatever it takes to keep him on her side.

(Source: Tappytoon)

150081.description:
Why do you shine so brightly when you refuse to give it to me? I think I'm starting to grow greedy.Yu-Seong and Mirinae were initially set to make their debut together. But, like stars pouring down towards Mirinae, Yu-Seong became a distant person that he couldn't approach nor grasp. And without interacting as much as possible, I didn't want to be enthralled by that face.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

150082.description:
For the past ten years, Baek Ha-Yeon has been living in guilt for ruining the life of his love, Yoon Yi-Han. Because of this, he feels he has no right to object when Yi-Han wishes to continue their relationship despite getting married. At the same time, Yi-Han’s cousin, Yoon Jin-Woon, has been using their secret as leverage to get Ha-Yeon to sleep with him since he also has feelings for him.

Just when the lives of these three seem to have gotten so irreversibly tangled, Ha-Yeon is sent ten years into the past before the biggest regret of his life occurred. Though he is determined to alter the course of this timeline and save Yi-Han’s life, he wants to keep ignoring Jin-Woon’s blatant feelings for him.

However, when Jin-Woon offers to help Ha-Yeon avoid the very cause of his problem, the two become entwined all over again…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

150086.description:
Each book is a debt of love. Each step forward is a mortal challenge.

150087.description:
Xie Shiye entered the entertainment industry and worked hard to become famous because of Fu Xu. Fu Xu was his dream and his light. When he finally worked his way up to fame, Fu Xu suddenly announced his retirement from the entertainment industry. Xie Shiye wondered if he should cuss at him.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150089.description:
Some people are just drawn together…literally. Eun Se-eun has never gotten over his first love and eternal crush, the charismatic and effervescent Seo Jeongwoo. Unable to forget him, Se-eun decides to take things into his own hands - by making them the main characters of his hit BL series, Can’t Get Caught! XXX. But after returning to his hometown, Se-eun’s fantasy just might become reality when he comes face to face with the man of his dreams (and drawings) once again! As the two begin to reignite their friendship from years gone by, Se-eun must do whatever he can to ensure Jeongwoo doesn’t find out what he’s been up to. He can run, he can hide...but he can’t get caught!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and five side stories.

150090.description:
In order to get revenge on his ex-boyfriend, Ha-Neul starts seeing his ex’s-boyfriend's younger brother, Hyeon-Seong. As a co-pilot, Hyeon-Seong meets frequently with Ha-Neul, who runs a flower shop nearby the airport. Then one day, Ha-Neul receives a call from his ex-boyfriend.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

150091.description:
Gyeongwoo lives and dies by his viewer count. He’d jump through fiery hoops if it meant going viral, even if it meant going live with his personal nemesis, Do Jiho—the reigning king of the platform and the one person Gyeongwoo wants to punch in the face. Forced into a room with his arch-rival for a live-streamed penalty game, Gyeongwoo promises his fans he'll do whatever they ask. But as the live chat's requests grow increasingly shameless, Gyeongwoo realizes too late that Jiho isn't just playing along for the views—he's using the broadcast to finally make Gyeongwoo his own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Gosuwi BL Danpyeonseon (고수위 BL 단편선) Collection.

Rebooted manga based on the anime TV series.

150093.description:
His stern, strait-laced boss has suddenly become a little kid?!

Soon after starting his job at a realty office, Shimizu discovered that the infamously unfriendly boss Mr. Ueno actually did pay careful attention to his employees. Since then, Shimizu has been unbearably fascinated with the man, and yet equally unable to grow any closer to him. When he idly makes a wish on a meteor shower one night, and Mr. Ueno calls in sick the next day, Shimizu goes to check in on him only to find out that his boss has somehow turned into a preschool-aged boy...?!

This romantic comedy starring a big puppy of a realtor and his surly but earnest boss will cleanse your soul with its pure sweetness

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

150104.description:
Callia Taxicate was a mere commoner until she saved the life of Simon Tereloane, the son of a duke. In return, the duke helps make her commander of the emperor's knights and she becomes a war hero. Though she only sees Simon as a friend, the two unexpectedly spend the night together and she ends up pregnant! Terrified that he and his noble family won't accept a child out of wedlock, Callia runs away to raise the baby on her own. But how long can she hide this secret, especially from the father?!

(Source: Tapas)

150105.description:
According to urban legend, the guilty are sentenced to fall to the Tokyo Underworld. There, they are given no mercy and are mercilessly judged for their crimes in the cruelest ways imaginable!!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes 37 extra chapters.

150106.description:
When Hazel Mayfield is sent to live with the Martins as a child, she falls in love with rural life and vows to have a farm of her own one day. Eleven years later, she receives an unexpected windfall as her grandfather hands her the deed to a plot of land in the middle of the capital. Ecstatic, Hazel sets out to realize her longtime dream of becoming a farmer. There’s only one problem: Her new farm is right next to the imperial palace! And it seems the emperor himself has his eye on her land…

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Marronnier Farm Near by the Imperial Palace
皇宮裡的馬洛尼埃農場
宮殿の隣のマロニエ農場

150107.description:
What if your soul could leave your body and possess people -- or even animals? Thanks to an incident in the past, that’s what happens to Marshall Lidiance every time she passes out or falls asleep. No one knows her little secret, but things become problematic for Marshall when she gets absorbed into a teddy bear owned by the icy-cold Duke Ludvillian! Will Marshall be able to figure out what caused the soul absorption while still keeping it a secret from everyone?

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: ตุ๊กตาหมีของท่านดยุก

150108.description:
As high society's most eligible lady, Sierra Fernein did whatever it took to please her family, despite their flagrant disregard for her. But upon discovering she has only a month left to live, she decides to go on strike from being a prim and proper lady and live life on her own terms. Shedding the Fernein name, she declares war on anyone who dares get in her way, including her family and a few pesky admirers. But with just 30 days left, can Sierra finally enjoy the life of her dreams?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.
synonyms: I Went on Strike Because My Time Was Limited
ขอเทนะคะ ชีวิตนี้มีเวลาจำกัด

150109.description:
Min-Ji and Yu-Na have been best friends since high school, and Min-Ji counts herself lucky to have someone so pretty and kind in her life. She just knows that when she finally starts dating, she wants it to be with someone as amazing as Yu-Na! Everything seems perfect, but things start to change when Min-Ji begins having dirty dreams… ones starring Yu-Na herself! Min-Ji chalks it up to her own loneliness, but for some reason Yu-Na starts acting strangely when Min-Ji tells her about it… Is she upset, or could it be that Yu-Na has harbored feelings for Min-Ji all along? From unrequited love, excitement, and obsession, just where will these bad thoughts lead them?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: BAD THINKING DIARY：バット・シンキング・ダイアリー

150110.description:
"I just want to be me!"
I hate "boring."
"Fun" is non-negotiable!
Natsuna is a powerful girl who freely and uninhibitedly pursues her "desires."

"Because..."
"But..."
"I can't..."
Men, women, the outside world, and self-inhibition are all just "blocks."
Fuyumi is a literary girl who feels like, "I still haven't found what I'm looking for."

The unknown world where these two contrasting girls meet is...... SM! Two dominatrices, "Kanna" and "Touko," are the newest members of the SM scene!

Laughter! Life! Humanity! They will live life with all their might!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

150111.description:
Your precious letter has been found by "that girl" ...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

150112.description:
In a world of dreams that invites with a sweet and gentle touch, there lies a road flooded with joy traveled by two. Inhabiting a teapot are the tsukumogami Chaki and Ryu—their job is to pour delicious tea. However, following the teapot’s dwindling use, it one day eventually breaks. As for what awaits them on their departure to the outside world…

A baby mountain who doesn’t know what they’re supposed to be.
Chaki's water-person copycat.
Yamada-kun who wears a mysterious costume.

...And many other strange, eccentric characters, including the beginner-ghost Marimo coupled with her veteran-ghost grandmother, and the truly kind Ijiwaru coupled with a stuck-on-tail cat, all spread gracefully across a mysterious world.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

150113.description:
She is a regular at the public bathhouse, a nice babe, really. But she's always in low spirits, so this time I want to make her laugh...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

150116.description:
Susan is the perfect and sweet female lead–or so the novel says. Because of this, the newly possessed Lady Medena Rodenherg doesn’t think twice about supporting the protagonist on her journey. However, the story Medena knows isn’t the entire truth, and Susan is actually far from the kind girl she’s been portrayed to be on the pages. This becomes most apparent when she ultimately betrays Medena and has her unjustly executed. Now back in time before ever meeting Susan, Medena decides to take the opposite approach in this life and team up with the novel’s antagonist, Pharren. Lucky for her, Pharren may not entirely be the wicked villain Medena has read about in the original novel…

(Source: Tappytoon)

"Your face makes me want to see you cry."

Those were the words that started a hot and thrilling work with a scary but handsome director. Am I actually an "M"?

There's a serial killer in my WeChat Moments! There seems to be a mysterious large organization behind everything. The only one I can rely on is my buddy who sleeps on my lower bunk.

(Source: Webnovel)

150124.description:
One day, the orphan AnLe surprisingly woke up to find an extraordinarily beautiful young man in his bed.

"Wait a minute! What the hell am I responsible for? I am a gentleman with good principles!"

It turns out that the young man is the little God of Wealth whom he asked help from to avoid a misfortune. However, upon assisting him, the God of Wealth temporarily lost his powers! In order to restore his magic, the God of Wealth must help AnLe do good deeds and make worship offerings. The chaotic* life of living together has officially begun!

(Source: iQiYi, translated)

A king of a powerful empire, and a queen of a small country, just married, together for their first night...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

150131.description:
Akira is the girl of Yuuto’s dreams—too bad she’s dating his big brother! Or was, at least. When she gets dumped, Yuuto thinks he has a chance to pick her up on the rebound… But his big bro ended the relationship for a reason. Akira is an obsessive, clingy stalker, a total trash fire of a girl who would happily manipulate Yuuto’s feelings for a chance to get near the man she loves again. Of course, Yuuto knows that, but it won’t stop him from going dumpster diving!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

150134.description: Universal Century, November 0079. A Komusai is shot at during a drop operation in order to send reinforcements to Odessa. The Komusai falls, unable to control its fight against gravity, and makes an emergency landing in an area of the Far East called Japan... The soldiers’ contacts with both Zeon and Federation forces shed new light on a hidden front of the One Year War.

150137.description: Wataru is a student more interested in partying with friends than in working. His older brother is dead, but he continues to live with his sister-in-law Miwa and his nephew. As Miwa runs an underwear shop, Wataru is nicknamed Pantsu (meaning panties) by his friends. They are convinced that Wataru is in love with Miwa, but he denies it. However, the day he learns that Miwa is dating an older man with a family, Wataru begins to doubt: what if his friends were right? What if it's too late?

150138.description: Gyamon is search of the legendary Necro-Head, a mysterious object that can read the future. He is accompanied by his team of outstanding treasure hunters directed to the planet Orcamonza-beak. To achieve his goal, he will have to overcome the most dangerous pitfalls and survive the most dangerous traps...

150139.description: At just 21, Asumi has just married Taisuke Koino, an employee of a women's lingerie manufacturer. This luscious, seductive, caring and attentive housewife is also so candid that she gets herself into funny... and daring situations! Fortunately, her equally affable husband is far too much in love with her to hold it against her.

150140.description: Cura is a tortured man. A baseball player in decline, he is also dealing with the trials of fatherhood. He is raising his only son alone and his failures on the field are a source of ridicule for the young boy. Riddled with a form of bestiality, Kiura has to juggle his own shortcomings with those of society on a daily basis. Yet his goal is simple: to make his son happy.

150141.description: Our story takes place during the Genroku era (1688 - 1704), a period of peace and stability. We follow the adventures of the samurai Bunzaemon Asahi, his love affairs and his enthusiastic way of life...

150142.description:
A star that loved a stalker, and a brother who lost his sibling.

On the day that star actor Yuri - who suddenly disappeared from the entertainment industry three years ago - makes a comeback, a flower basket is delivered to him along with a mysterious letter. After reading the letter, Yuri is stabbed by a stranger while trying to catch the sender. The culprit is Yuri's stalker, who had been pretending to be a delivery man. Just who is this mysterious stalker? Why does Yuri tirelessly chase him?

Meanwhile, Yuri's new manager Hyun continues to seep in to Yuri's life... Why does this man seem so familiar to Yuri?

A distorted love story between broken people, occurring within the flashy entertainment industry.

(Source: Copin Comics)

150143.description:
Love deprived, dating doormat meets a muscle-headed cherry boy!

Contrary to his haughty appearance, twenty two year old Jiwon Han is a complete doormat who pours his heart and soul into every single guy he dates.No matter how many times he is dumped after being used by his boyfriends, he's an affection deprived person that only feels loved when embraced by another.In front of him appears Kwonwoo, who is completely Jiwon's type of man, in appearance at least.It's love at first sight for Jiwon, but no matter how hard he tries to seduce Kwonwoo, it ends in failure.Will he be able to seduce the sports maniac, or will it end in another failure?

A "sexy comic love story" between a dating doormat who has never properly dated before, and a musclehead who only thinks of exercising."

(Source: Copin Comics)

title.english: Why Won't You Do It with Me

150144.description:
Hello everyone, I'm a cat butler. My masters are four cats with different personalities: the eldest brother Ahuang is obsessed with beauty, the second brother Huahua is the protector of the family, the third brother Bai used to be a stray and claims he can see mysterious creatures, and the youngest brother Xiaoxiao is a super foodie.

After moving into a new home, what kind of hilarious adventures await the cats!?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150146.description:
In order to make up for a mistake, the God of Fate sent his apprentice Ji Longyue into the mortal realm to become the daughter of a minister. Her job was to help the ineffective emperor Gu Xuanting to reform himself in order to become a wise ruler. She thought she would do that by becoming his queen, but she was appointed to be his bodyguard instead? He even gave her the title of General, which caused great dissatisfaction with the members of his court, and led to all sorts of unexpected events. This is not how the script was supposed to go! This emperor just can't be helped, how will she get out of this situation?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150148.description: Huo Xinyang was so tired of being heartbroken, over and over again, that she set out to teach a lesson to those two-faced men who promised so much but never delivered. She got so carried away by her so-called 'mission' that she did not realize how her role had become her second nature. But what will happen when an innocent-looking boy challenged her preconceptions? Will she toy with him like all the other guys she had ruined?
synonyms: Love Lock...ไขหัวใจนายวายร้าย

150149.description:
I'm not doing this because I'm greedy. I just wanted to be happy and go to school, just like everyone else. So was it my fault? Or because my parents were poor? Or—

(Source: Cycomi, translated)

150150.description:
As a new era dawns, humanity embarks on an epic adventure where everyone possesses game-like abilities. Cultivating as a warrior or mastering dark arts becomes the foundation of this unfolding story. During a blind date, the protagonist discovers that the new era is on the horizon, and his date, Tang Qingrou, reveals herself to be a reincarnated soul. And she claims I’m the future king!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: So They Prophesized, I'm the Future King
They Say I'm the Future King

title.romaji: Ta Men Shuo Wo Shi Weilai Zhi Wang

150153.description:
In the future, the convicts of Earth are exiled into space to preserve natural resources. The abandoned spaceship-turned-prison “Cosmic” has already expanded to their seventh habitat. Minkyu, Dustin and Huiming are Cosmic Seven's newest boarders. Minkyu, the crook who impersonated a doctor, looks for comfort in the kind guard Leo, while simultaneously feeling sympathy for the cannibal-murderer Niger...

(Source: Copin Comics)

150154.description:
Reiya Mizuki has a special ability. He is able to "ANALyze" whatever is put inside him. His family was torn apart after his father committed suicide because of the Serizawa Group and he wants revenge. He becomes a corporate spy and starts working for the company. His main target is the heir to the company, Kento Serizawa, the new director of the sales department. Reiya wants the top-secret clientele list that Kento has, so that he can leak the information and destroy the Serizawa Group. In order for Reiya to get his hands on the information, he needs to seduce Kento and make Kento fall for him. But Kento isn't easily charmed by Reiya's seduction and things are proving to be more difficult than he expected.

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Shirimen: Kachou no Are wo Namahame Ana Bunseki [Ana*lyze]!

150155.description: A manga anthology based on Osomatsu-san by the editorial department of Boy's Love publisher Libre Shuppan.

title.native: 「おそ松さん」公式アンソロジーコミック 愛しているのよおそ松さん♥
title.romaji: "Osomatsu-san" Koushiki Anthology: Aishiteiru no yo Osomatsu-san♥

title.native: 35歳の迷子たち～女の幸せってなんだっけ？～
title.romaji: 35-sai no Maigotachi: Onna no Shiawase tte Nandake?

150158.description:
The cat's out of the bag! Turns out that girl you thought you were in bed isn't what you thought!

Rindo Tachibana is a clerk at a piercing and accessories shop who is too kind for his own good. Unfortunately, he's got bad luck with the ladies, and on top of that...he's being stalked. When Rindo suddenly gets asked out by a girl who is everything he ever wanted, he feels it may be too good to be true. And it is. After getting handcuffed to the bed at a nearby love hotel, Rindo finds out that the girl he thinks is his type actually turns out to be a man...the man who's been stalking him! It feels a bit different hearing "I love you" from the man that ten minutes ago you thought was your ideal girl...

Get ready for a Boys' Love manga following a friendly man and his stalker that loves him dearly. What will come of their relationship after they have...sex?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: 我被變態跟蹤狂盯上了

title.native: 変態ストーカーに狙われてます

150159.description:
U.S. Sheriff Miro Jones is known for staying cool and keeping impatient sheriff Ian Doyle in check. During the three years of working together, they became excellent partners and good friends. However, things start to get complicated when their relationship develops beyond friendship

(Source: INKR)

150160.description:
He is an icy CEO, and she is a substitute bride. He is determined to seek revenge for the death of his brother and marries the woman he plans to torture but the bride is already substituted! Then what happens when the mistaken icy CEO acts so brutally upon the innocent substitute bride?

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: El Frío CEO Y Su Novia Sustituta
CEOเย็นชากับเจ้าสาวกำมะลอ
Le PDG froid et la mariée substitut

title.native: 冰山首席：枕上替嫁新娘
title.romaji: Bingshan Shouxi: Zhen Shang Ti Jia Xinniang

150161.description:
The daily life of Duoduo and his two adopted dads.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: My Daily Life With Two Dads

title.native: 有两个爸爸是种什么样的体验
title.romaji: You Liang Ge Baba Shi Zhong Shen Me Yang De Tiyan

150162.description:
When Seonwoo Baek was asked in high school why he liked Yujeong Ki, his answer was, “I just noticed one day that I always found myself looking for him. From the moment I first saw him, I haven’t been able to take my eyes off of him. It’s like he’s got the whole world on his shoulders or something. He looks like he might disappear at any moment, which makes me anxious, so I can’t take my eyes off him.” But after reuniting as adults, he’s still asking himself, “Am I gay or... do I just like YOU?”

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

150163.description:
Zhan Tian Bai, former General Chi Yan of the fallen Yao Guo empire, is captured and put up for auction. Bought by none other than the cunning Emperor Duan Mu Li, of Wang Li, the very person he once tried to assassinate. He is forced to become a slave to the enemy, whom originally wished only to break Tian Bai’s stubborn pride, but is he falling for his beauty instead? What will become of his fate?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: The Defeated General Must Become a Maid

150164.description:
Two childhood friends birthed into different positions face the hatred and greed of foul people. See how their relationship blooms into a wonderful garden.

(Source: Toomics)

150165.description:
The world now swarms with supernatural beings called Celestials and the Awakened, people with newfound special powers. But none of this means anything to Yoo Sungwon, an ordinary man trying to live an ordinary life. Unfortunately for him, his peaceful days end when he gets a mysterious text and becomes a rare SSS-class knight with perks to die for. In order to avoid getting killed or targeted by those who want his powers for their own, Sungwon has no choice but to get stronger by leveling up.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I have an SSS-rank Trait, but I want a Normal Life

title.english: The Carefree Life of an SSS-Class Knight
title.native: SSS급 특성을 받았지만 적당히 살고 싶다
title.romaji: SSS-geup Teukseongeul Badatjiman Jeokdanghi Salgo Sipda

150166.description:
In a future world, children hold the authority to determine who may become parents. Having children is illegal—unless a couple first passes a strict examination, conducted by a child, that certifies them as capable providers. It is a veritable utopia with no child abuse...or at least, so it may seem. Hikari is one such examiner in this system, spending his days evaluating prospective parents. But one day, he comes across a couple that isn't quite like the others...

(Source: Yen Press)

synonyms: What Happened After I Got Too Carried Away and Fucked My Younger Sister

title.native: 妹とノリでエッチした件 その後
title.romaji: Imouto to Nori de Ecchi Shita Ken: Sono Ato

150168.description:
An ordinary office worker is recruited by the Yakuza for "one reason" and his crazy destiny is set in motion!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

150169.description:
I transferred to a town where a mysterious floating object called "ULO" floats around, and I met a girl who only looked up at the sky.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

150170.description:
After "outboxer009" wakes up in the body of Jude Bayer from Legend of Heroes 2, he soon discovers that his rival "sandstorm" has also entered the game world as Cordelia Chace. These top-two-ranked old pros come to realize that navigating this game world is much harder than just pointing and clicking. With the apocalyptic conclusion of the game looming before them, they'll have to combine his quick wit, her foul mouth, and both their gamer mindsets to make a new, less cataclysmic ending.

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: エンディングメーカー
Ending Maker: Os Arquitetos do Fim

150171.description:
Johnny works for a food magazine "Heartbeat! Cuisine" as a reporter and that's the reason why he meets his Mr. Heartbeat Zac who is a famous baker in neighborhood nearby. So we draw "Endless" to depict to show that how great and sweet the couple is, just like cakes Zac makes.

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: さよならタイムマシン

150173.description:
Gaku became my best friend when I was alone. As long as he is here, everything will be fine...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ヨウちゃんはもう手の中
title.romaji: You-chan wa mou Te no Naka

150174.description:
What would you do if you were able to clone things with a single touch? Sometimes, having two of everything isn't such a great idea.

(Source: Toomics)

150175.description:
On a pitch-black night, corporate wage slave Qi Yan sees his first love — the one that had passed 10 years before. After quite a bit of pestering and persuasion, he finds himself forced into the miserable lifestyle of working during the day and investigating at night. The topic of the investigation? Finding out who the culprit is. Can the top who had passed years before successfully manage to be resurrected?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 7 extras.

150176.description:
A black-belly stubborn CEO x A strong show-off celebrity

Separated by 5 years, during his most difficult times, Yang Jiali met his ex-boyfriend again. A few years ago, his ex had pampered him too much, but torments him to death now. He wants to preserve his music band, but his ex purchased the management company and wants them to disband. He tried his best to gather resources, but his ex messed everything up.

Yang Jiali: You didn't plan on letting me go from the start, did you?
Ex-boyfriend: What do you think?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Be watched by my EX again
Being Watched by my Ex Again

title.romaji: You Bei Qian Nanyou Ding Shangle

150178.description:
"If you can not kiss your first love, you die!" Since his childhood, Woo Jae-yoon has no intention of life because of his illness. One day, a demon appears suddenly, and if he fails to fulfill the terms of the contract, he will die. And the condition is to kiss my first love ...! First-time candidates who continue to appear! Can Daoyun meet a first love and kiss?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

150180.description:
Junko was cheated by her boyfriend and lost both her love and her job because of the affair. She won five-million yen in the lottery, but her mood did not improve and she still felt desperately depressed.... Then a handsome, young, mysterious stranger appeared in front of her... "Would you like to be my sugar mommy?"

(Source: Renta, translated)

Note: Originally serialized in Renai Tengoku magazine under the name "Mamakatsu, Hajimemasu," the title was changed for the tankoubon release.

She was just a kid...then, the present caught up.

(Source: Fakku)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2022-06

Soft-skinned, cosplay booth babe. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2022-05

title.romaji: Onaho Kyoushitsu Shingakki: Joseito Ninshin Shioki Keikaku

150184.description:
Olivia was a lone monster subjugator who refused to take on an apprentice until she rescued a young Beastkin named Noah. Now, they look out for one another in an often brutal world. Despite the dangers they face, the two at times find beauty in their shared journey. As Olivia teaches Noah the art of battle, he teaches her how to enjoy life’s quieter moments. But can a boy with such a tender heart live up to his apprenticeship when faced with terrifying foes?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Cool Onee-san has a problem that I can't tell anyone

title.romaji: Cool-kei Onee-san ni wa Dare ni mo Ienai Nayami ga Aru.

150186.description:
Irosaki-san, a beautiful high school English teacher, is constantly being gawked at by her male students in the throes of puberty… or is she just imagining things? A slightly erotic but quite funny delusional school comedy!

(Source: Kurage Bunch, translated)

title.native: 都市伝説先生ウラモン

150189.description:
Would you like to go on a journey together with the bumbling sorcerer's apprentice Arthur? With the Sword of Din and the Lyre of Rion in hand, he aims for the Sky Labyrinth at the northern end of the world. An awe-inducing adventure story that is both scary and exciting!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Notes:
- Includes the one-shot "Aoi Yami no Kuni kara (青い闇の国から)"
- Includes the one-shot "Lingual no Ryousen (リンガルの稜線)"
- Includes the one-shot "Kinkoushoku nasu Morikage (金紅色なす森蔭)"

150190.description:
In Hercion Academy's Magic Department, which trains the best wizards on the continent, lives Luciel, who is called the "iron-blooded assistant" and is recognized for her ability. What she's hoping for is to become a professor and live a normal flowery life!!!

But three men appear in front of her.

Prince Lassen, a scheming prince with a cold heart. Ethan, the swordmaster who has a straight chivalrous spirit like the sunshine. Taylor, the most popular and cute genius in magic. It's hard to achieve the dream of an ordinary life, but because of them, Luciel's plan is becoming more difficult.

Can she really love someone?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: This is the promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.
synonyms: I Just Want to Walk on the Flower Road

150191.description:
Kaji's a college student who works part-time at a cafe. One day,he receives a business card with the title "Development Director" from Keigo who works at an adult toys manufacturer. With his curiosity peaked,he meets up with Keigo outside the café, but he's surprised by Keigo's passion for his job, his cuteness, and ditzy nature... Kaji falls head over heels for Keigo,but there seems to be no trace of reciprocation from Keigo...!
Keigo's oblivious to everything outside his job, so how will he ever notice Kaji's feelings for him...!? In addition to the three-part cover story, this compilation also includes a variety of short stories; everything from a love story that starts from an awkward relationship, to a guy with a younger boyfriend who acts like a dog, to a pair of friends who escalate their relationship to something deeper!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 開発部長のヒミツのおしごと
title.romaji: Kaihatsu Buchou no Himitsu no Oshigoto

150192.description: The Japanese arm of PlayStation published on Twitter a 12 page mini-manga dedicated to Call of Duty Vanguard, drawn by Hiro Mashima.
synonyms: Polina Petrova: The Best Female Sniper in the World
コールオブデューティヴァンガード: ポリーナペトロワ

title.native: CALL OF DUTY VANGUARD: POLINA PETROVA　最強の女性スナイパー
title.romaji: CALL OF DUTY VANGUARD: POLINA PETROVA - Saikyou no Josei Sniper

150193.description:
“You useless son of mine! You were supposed to pull master swordsman, but I never thought it would be this tragic!”

The day a child turns fifteen, they undergo the Ritual of Divine Blessing. Already descended from a line of master swordsman, Elymas was supposed to succeed his father. However, he pulls the defective class, the Heavy Knight, and not only loses his status as future head of the household, but he's also exiled. With their unbalanced stats and seemingly useless skills, Heavy Knights are spoked of as a class for cowards and the lazy. However, Elymas knows the truth. The world he lives in is the same as the one of the game he used to play... It is the Heavy Knight that is the most powerful class of them all. Using memories from his past life, Elymas has set out to effectively conquer this entire world.

(Source: K MANGA)
synonyms: The Exiled Reincarnated Heavy Knight Is Unrivaled in Game Knowledge
추방당한 전생 중기사는 게임 지식으로 무쌍한다

title.english: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
title.native: 追放された転生重騎士はゲーム知識で無双する
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Chishiki de Musou Suru

150194.description:
“You good-for-nothing bastard. You are the son of a Sword Saint, yet you dare pull such a defective Class!?”

During the "Divine Blessing Ceremony" of the 15-year-old Elma who came from a lineage of Sword Saints, he had manifested a commonly deemed defective class known as the Heavy Knight. He had been deprived of his position as the next head of the Edvan Household and was then exiled. The Heavy Knight class had an unbalanced status and useless skills, to top it off, it was even said to be a class cowardly and indolent people have. But, Elma knew better—that this world was the world of the game he had used to play before—and that the Heavy Knight class was the strongest class to exist. Elma made full use of the knowledge he had in his previous life and began his efficient walkthrough of the world he was reincarnated into.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Exiled Reincarnated Heavy Knight Is Unrivaled in Game Knowledge

title.native: 追放された転生重騎士はゲーム知識で無双する
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Chishiki de Musou Suru

150195.description:
"To those who live in this world, 'a walking total body of shame'." What kind of world is this? Much, much more than others. Shinichiro Tsuji is a freelancer with a complex about his thin body hair. Again and again, he would look at his smooth arms and crotch in the bathtub at home and feel depressed, remembering the teasing of his friends. He would close his eyes and ponder over things as usual. Today, too, his daily routine was supposed to go by like that. When he looked up, he found himself in a foreign palace.

When I looked up, I found myself in a foreign palace. I was mesmerized by the glossy hair fluttering in front of me. And in the blink of an eye, I became a prisoner. Among the people in the royal palace who never saw this, the only one who called out to Shinichiro and touched him was the youngest prince, Prince Falu. His body reacts to the hairy man who touches him as if he is probing him..

(Source: Eiwa Shuppansha)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: いとしの毛むくじゃら

title.romaji: Sensei ni Noroi wo Kakeru Houhou

title.romaji: Gyakuten Ouji: Ikemen Ouji de Aru Kono Ore ga Isekai Tensei Shitara Naze ga Busaiku ni!

150200.description:
When she opened her eyes, she was lying in an unknown place with an unknown person.
She can't even remember her own name, so she calls herself Nine after 009, which is written on her attire.
In the same way, she tries to get out of this prison-like place with ‘Gong-Chil’, who is connected to the number 007.
The more you struggle, the deeper you fall into the labyrinth. What clues can you find in this mysterious place and lost memories?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

150203.description:
The labyrinth calls, and is answered by adventurers, profiteers, and anyone looking to make a quick buck. And in this town inhabited by the dregs of society live a man, and the woman who owns him. Arwen, the Princess knight with lofty dreams of restoring her homeland—and Matthew, the town drunk. As Arwen challenges the labyrinth, Matthew spends his days in taverns and brothels living off the money he gets from her. But the town laughingstock has a side that no one knows about. In service of Arwen, Matthew would do anything—no matter how dirty he might get.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: He is a kept man for the princess knight.

title.english: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight

150205.description:
The love story of two broken people who save each other.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150206.description:
Peach-pheromone Luo Zhiyu and tangerine-pheromone Xiao Yan have had an ongoing feud since they were 3 years old. The both of them have a 0% pheromone match, yet they’re always together. When they graduated, they finally realized that they were blinded by their scientism…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 5 extras.

title.romaji: Xinxi Su Shuo Women Bu Keneng

150207.description:
The male protagonist goes on a business trip and coincidentally shares a love-themed room with a famous e-sports player. What’s with the transparent bathroom door and vibrating bed? The next day, the two go their separate ways. When the male protagonist gets frustrated with work and goes to drink at a roadside stall, the man who shared a room with him suddenly appears and calls him his idol. Wait a minute? What’s going on? I already quit e-sports three years ago! Don’t you dare try to tempt me back into playing!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150211.description:
As a rabbit spirit, Xiao Mian has modest dreams: visit heaven, meet its super sexy king, and…become a god?! When the king of spirits, Liu Yan, makes a royal request for a wife, she sees an opening. But why would a king want a lowly spirit like her?

(Source: Tapas)

150212.description: <i>Note: This doujin chapter got re-published on the mangaka's own Twitter account on May 30, 2022.<i>

Bareteru Dansou Shoujo Super Heroine to Yuujou no Hanashi

150213.description:
Sora Hometani is a student who transforms into a pomeranian when stressed due to his special physique. Until one day, Sora's classmate and secret crush Makito Matsuda sees Sora in his pomeranian form, and brings him home for his grandma to overcome her sadness of losing her old pomeranian Pometa...

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

20-sai Over demo Mahou Shoujo Yattete mo Ii Janai! tte Hanashi

title.romaji: Bareteru! Setsumei Kai wa Onsen de...no Wake!

150216.description:
On a seemingly uneventful day, the sky suddenly cracked, and countless monsters fell from the sky. With his innate Yin-Yang eyes, Yi Tianxing, the hero, survived the "seven-day apocalypse" with his sister and his teammates on Earth difficultly. Then thousands of planets appeared out of nowhere, and they began to merge with the Earth, forming a giant planet. Then the Earth started a new chapter called the Eternal Kingdom.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: バレてる！スーパーヒロインの香り

150218.description:
Haru is the eldest daughter of the Kogome Family. The Kogome family has been considered a 'fallen' family with barely a penny to their name. To save face, Haru must marry a rich young man to improve the family standing. As it is, her recent arrangement with warrant officer Narihira Hishii is Haru's last chance in securing a marriage. To everyone's surprise, Narihira falls in love with Haru at first sight and immediately proposes marriage. Overwhelmed, Haru asked for more time to think about it. So starts the love story between modern woman Haru and the persistent Officer Narihira.

(Source: Manga Planet)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

バレてる！女の子もスケベってホントですか信じていいんですか？

幼なじみが幼なじみに異性感じちゃうマン!!!!!!
title.romaji: Osananajimi ga Osananajimi ni Iseikanji Chau Man!!!!!!
Boujuu no Su no M Shounen

150224.description:
My childhood goddess became a freshman boy at my university?! Can I break that romantic promise made in my childhood...? Junior boy that is lukewarm in appearance and shrewd inside x Intense, changeable senior boy that sees himself as apathetic.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Xue Di Zong Xiang Yao Liao Wo

150225.description:
I'm a superstar in the making but somehow got turned into a cat. What's worse is that I fell into the hands of my nemesis! Being ignorant of the situation, he petted me, kissed me, and hugged me. Whatever. I'll forgive him for that. B-but it looks like he's after my body too! Despicable! Someone, please come and save me!!!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: I’ll Work Hard as a Cat Today

title.romaji: Jintian Ye Yao Nuli Dang Zhi Mao

150226.description:
The school bully has a nemesis—a rival in love who likes to snitch. The worst thing is that his nemesis is bad at recognizing faces and is oblivious to everything he does. Move aside, love rival. You're in the way of me pursuing my dream girl!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

150228.description:
The story of Asia's Champion and his opponent.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.english: Does Love At First Sight Exist in E-Sports?
title.native: 电子竞技存在一见钟情吗？

150229.description:
Xiao Yu, who just graduated from university, was cheated out of an offer from a big company, and by chance came to a company called "Luo Feng Life Management Consulting" to do technical development. Although the colleagues in this small company are enthusiastic, something seems wrong. The boss is a handsome man with 2.8 meter aura, but he was so angry while playing web games during work hours that he had a fight with some elementary school students...

Xiao Yu thought he had joined an unreliable and fraudulent company, but he didn't expect that the staff were not living people, and he was the only living person in this company!!

It's over, I have to use my strength to get along well with the boss, otherwise I will be punished to being a prostitute in my next life! !

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Adapted from the web novel Xin Shiji, Xin Shiji (新世纪， 新冥界)

title.native: よろコンビニ挟まれて

150232.description:
What?! Traversing to become a Master? The job with the highest risk factor? No! I won't become a Master, even if you kill me!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Not Becoming a Master Even If You Kill Me

title.romaji: Da Si Ye Bu Zuo Shi Zun

150233.description:
When a mission goes terribly wrong, the top-ranking divine beast killer of the world suddenly finds himself as a simple pet to ordinary human Ji Keyuan. The once proud divine beast must constantly find ways to keep his new owner happy ever since then… what a hard life he has now.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: I Have a Divine Beast at Home

150235.description:
When Li Yuze first debuted, he made his marriage public. The media was flabbergasted. It was the talk of the town. However, no one could figure out who he was married to. After a while, the fans started doubting the validity of the news. After all, no one saw the rumored mysterious wife...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.native: 秘密のファンサービス♥

150243.description: Includes “Psychic Agent Onohara Mei: Sono Go” (サイキック・エージェント小野原メイ・その後) published in Comic Aun 2021-02.
synonyms: Psychic Agent Onohara Mei: Sono Go

150244.description:
1. Imouto ni Kareshi Dekita toka Arienai (妹に彼氏できたとかありえない); Comic Aun 2021-04
2. Oniichan no Omocha (お兄ちゃんのおもちゃ); Comic Aun 2021-08
3-4. dicktok ; Comic Aun 2021-02, 06
5-6. Imouto Mesu Ochi Choukyou Haishin (妹メス堕ち調教配信); Comic Aun 2021-10, 12
7. Imouto Haramase Taikyuu Haishin (妹孕ませ耐久配信); Comic Aun 2022-02
8. Futsutsuka na Imouto Desu ga (ふつつかな妹ですが); Comic Aun 2022-04
synonyms: Imouto ni Kareshi Dekita toka Arienai

150245.description: Note: Published in 19 parts on Giba-chan's PixivFANBOX account.

150247.description: Note: Published for the 99th edition of the Comiket.
synonyms: You Are My Angel I Am...?

title.native: あなたは天使で私は狼
title.romaji: Anata wa Tenshi de Watashi wa Ookami

synonyms: グリーン・ティー・ドリーム

150249.description:
An obscenely rich girl with crazy dreams has a family with quite some secrets. After finding her grandmother's book on witchcraft, she hatches a plan to get the boy of her dreams. She uses the book to create the guy of her dreams, but the unexpected result came with a fish tail!

(Source: INKR)

150250.description:
"Should I make you purr?" We let our eyes do the talking... ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2022-06

150252.description:
A light-hearted everyday story of a group of people fighting with a group of gods.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

150254.description:
Urban anomalies, strange and bizarre tales, endless staircases, suddenly appearing doors, familiar places and people, silent disappearances and deaths, and... an old hand scholar x rich second-generation slacker (not really). We are the guardians of the night, fighting to the end!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150255.description:
Fiola, seventeen years old, likes to stay at her room writing novels. And she has a secret identity...she is Riethe Rasteau, author of the best-selling novel "Clash of Angels". When she attends a party at the Palace, she accidentally finds out that the cool and handsome prince is one of the biggest fans of her works. She becomes friends with him, hiding that she is Rasteau. Then one day, Fiola's family gets in a big trouble...she must find the culprit of the serial murder case by herself. Now she needs to use her identity as Rasteau and ask help from the prince! A love comedy with suspense.

(Source: BookWalker)

title.english: The Misadventures of the Otaku Prince and the Bestselling Author
title.native: オタク王子とベストセラー作家令嬢の災難
title.romaji: Otaku Ouji to Bestseller: Sakka Reijou no Sainan

150256.description: It's a story about a romance between a slightly strange girl and a normal guy.

title.native: 闇川さんはやみかわいい

150257.description:
Tamako Miura (30) runs Teishoku-ya, a restaurant with only eight seats, inherited from her father. It is a restaurant that does not require any reservations, and people who go to Teishoku-ya always somehow feel better, so the place is quite busy. In fact, Tamako has a secret as to why her food makes the body feels better.......? Please enjoy the combination of a little alcohol with a variety of colorful dishes suited for your physical condition. The dishes in this volume include "Sake Steamed Scallion and Rape Flower," "Bonito Zuke Donburi," "Ginger Pudding," and 21 others in all! Enjoy this new gourmet manga that will make you drool!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: たまこ定食 注文のいらないお店
title.romaji: Tamako Teishoku: Chuumon no Iranai Omise

150258.description:
Hinagi is a child, lost in a land unknown to her, awoken by an ill-intentioned stranger who found her unconscious on the roadside. With much trepidation she sets off to Shambala, a prosperous and bustling city just outside of Nirvana. With the assistance of a mysterious exiled monk bent on taking down the entire foundation on which Shambala stands, Hinagi will have to choose between allowing faith to blind her or opening her eyes to the possibility that not all is how it seems.

(Source: Mangamo)

150259.description:
Souji Aida, a man with a steel-like mental toughness unfazed by anything, was accidentally transferred to "Shura High," a notorious school filled with the worst delinquents. The only rule in this school is "The strongest are free to do whatever they want." Souji was immediately "baptized" by the school's unwritten rules as he was picked on and bullied. But that only made him more determined to become the strongest in order to win his "freedom" and achieve his ultimate goal of finding a girlfriend among the rare four girls in the school. The story is about a young man who is determined to become the most powerful of all. A new-era "male mythology" by an up-and-coming author!

(Source: Weekly Young Magazine)

title.native: 令和雄王　相田宗二

150260.description:
Chen Xu was the most powerful god-emperor in heaven and earth, but his body was disintegrated by the combined attack of four other god-emperors. His soul could only escape by reincarnating into the body of a weak young master. As a once nearly invincible being, he wasn't about to put up with being bullied in this life. Chen Xu swore he will regain his powers and have his bloody revenge, but he had to start his immortal cultivation with an incomplete technique manual. Little did he realize, that this incomplete manual is about to make his road to immortality a lot more interesting.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.native: 最强神皇的废柴重置人生
title.romaji: Zui Qiang Shenhuang De Feichai Chongzhi Rensheng

150261.description:
When Ding Xiaoyi's grandfather died, the Ding enterprises went bankrupt, and Ding Xiaoyi thought his life as a rich heir was over. But his grandfather had left him an inheritance, a house with land on the road to the underworld! Monsters, artifacts, curses.... a strange new world is about to open up for Ding Xiaoyi.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Huangquan You Zuo Fang

150262.description:
Ling Enping wanted to prove his father's innocence and bring his family back to prominence, but he had no magical abilities to do so, until one day when he accidentally triggered the Dragon Farming System. Suddenly, he became a talented magician, the most powerful mage in the empire took him on as an apprentice, the king made him a duke, and he even became engaged to the princess. But amidst all the accolades lurked many hidden dangers, and even the System that helped awaken his talent was hiding a conspiracy of its own...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: The Newbie Mage's Secret Dragon Farm

150263.description:
After our male protagonist transmigrated, he was somehow taken in by the all-women Yunü Sect, and given a job as the doorman. When he jumped to the other world, he was blessed with the Super Sign-In System and given the unprecedented ability of Carnal Cultivation. He had to stimulate women, and their excitement will become his cultivation. The Yunü Sect was threatened by enemies on all sides. To protect his (women) saviors, he will take advantage of the Super Sign-In System to defeat enemies, slay demons, fight off monsters, conquer the wilds, and make himself into a god.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Changed My Life By Signing In
By Registering, My Life Has Been Altered
My Life Changed In Another World
ミッションクリアが世界を救う

title.romaji: Wo Kao Qian Dao Ni Tian Gai Ming

150264.description:
An ordinary high school boy, Yamano Itta, indulges his cross-dressing hobby by transforming himself into a beautiful girl named "Ichigo" once a week! One day, "Ichigo" ran into Kisaragi, a popular boy at school, and their sweet-and-sour romance will begin......!

(Source: Comic Pool, translated)

Notes:
- Originally self-published on Twitter as "女装が趣味の高1男子" (Josou ga Shumi no Kou 1 Danshi, Crossdressing High School Freshman), the first chapters were collected for commercial publication by Comic Pool on 2022-05-20 with the new name.
- Chapter count includes eight extras chapters.

title.native: 日曜日のいちごちゃん

150265.description: An adaptation of Giant Robo THE ANIMATION: Chikyuu ga Seishi Suru Hi OVA, serialized in magazine Comic GENKi.

150266.description:
During the day, she is the "goddess of beauty," a personal trainer inspiring others to get better. But at night, after work, she gets hungry and down on herself. That's when the handsome but mysterious young man Tsukiyomi-kun appears to cook her a meal that fills her up and heals her soul, even though they've signed a contract that banned any romantic feelings between them. It's a sweet forbidden gourmet love-comedy between two people!

(Source: BeLove, translated)

title.native: 月読くんの禁断お夜食

synonyms: Sorry, Did You Wait for Me?

150268.description: A lyrical love story about Karen Domotojima, a tall girl show worries about her height, depicting her sweet and sad adolescence.

title.native: ラジカルかれんちゃん

150269.description:
The human body is a representation of the world, controlled by internal desires. Desire is driven by will. The will communicates desires through the body and governs our world.

When your world becomes dazzling and shining like never before because of the arrival of a person, you should be alert. That is the collapse of will.

Indifferent college student x cold and rational associate professor.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150270.description:
While under the cover identity "Murong Yan," the crown prince became smitten with the palace guard, Gu Lang, after a fated encounter. The two had to part ways after "Murong Yan" died, but the crown prince couldn't resist trying to get close to his beloved once again... this time under a different cover identity.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: Your Royal Highness, Your Vest Is off Again
Your Highness the Crown Prince, Your Mask Has Dropped Again

title.english: There Goes Your Cover Again, Your Highness
title.native: 太子殿下你的马甲又掉了
title.romaji: Tianzi Dianxia Ni de Majia You Diaole

150271.description:
“Young Master Chi, I doubt you’ll help me unconditionally. Am I right?”
“You’ll find out soon enough what this deal entails. Now, all you need to do is to give me an answer. Do you want this opportunity or not?”
“Yes, I do.”

Chi Mingyao made a deal with an actor who was brave enough to block him because of a car accident. He only wanted to tease the little actor at first, but eventually, he genuinely wanted to befriend Li Yangxiao and pass on his good luck to Li Yangxiao—just so Yangxiao can chase after his dreams without a care in the world.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150272.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 31

150273.description: Note: Published in COMIC HOTMiLK Koime Vol. 33

title.native: 一日百回（くらい）目が合う後輩女子マネージャーが想っていること
title.romaji: Ichinichi Hyakukai (Kurai) Me ga Au Kouhai Joshi Manager ga Omotteiru Koto

150276.description:
Sandai Fujiwara, a socially bottom-tier boy, sits in front of Shino Yuizaki, a beautiful gal at the top of the social caste.

Physically, they are very close to each other, but with their difference in status, it feels like they live in different worlds, never crossing paths with each other.

Until Sandai found Shino stuck in a ditch, having accidentally slipped.

“Thanks for the shower”

“Well, goodbye then.”

Although he takes Shino home on a whim to let her shower, Sandai remains wary of the gal. However, he finds himself increasingly attracted to Shino, who despite her looks, is actually not that experienced with men, even as she aggressively approaches him.

After some trouble, the two start dating, and begin to spend their days sweetly flirting with each other…….
synonyms: The Gal In The Back Seat Likes Me. I Might Not Make It Anymore.
Ushiro no Seki no Gyaru ni Sukarete Shimatta. Mou Ore wa Dame Kamo Shirenai
後ろの席のぎゃるに好かれてしまった。もう俺は駄目かもしれない。
The gal is sitting behind me, and loves me.
被坐在後面的辣妹喜歡上，我快要沒轍了。
ผมโดนสาวแกลโต๊ะหลังบอกรัก ใจผมบางไม่ไหวเเล้วเนี่ย

title.native: うしろの席のぎゃるに好かれてしまった。 もう俺はダメかもしれない。
title.romaji: Ushiro no Seki no Gal ni Sukarete Shimatta. Mou Ore wa Damekamoshirenai

150277.description:
Hugo is stuck in a time loop, forced to relive the same life up until the moment he is slain by one of his relatives. But after swearing revenge on his murderous family during his seventh reset, he meets a beautiful girl. According to rumor, this girl is a monster in human flesh, but he agrees to become her servant all the same. The birth of their partnership heralds an intertwining of fates, and Hugo's life will never be the same again…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: In My Seventh Life, I Met a Monster Princess
title.native: 僕は七度目の人生で、怪物姫を手に入れた
title.romaji: Boku wa Nanadome no Jinsei de, Kaibutsu Hime wo Teniireta

150278.description:
One learned to slowly become accepting while the other slowly started maturing... This is a story about going with the flow.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

title.native: ギルド最強VSクールな受付嬢
title.romaji: Guild Saikyou VS Cool na Uketsukejou

150281.description:
In one year, humanity’s Savior Kamishiro Fuuka—will die.

And yet one day, during our first meeting no less, she approached me.

“Please go out with me.”

As her boyfriend, it now became my duty to go through all sorts of events and plans she marked in her ‘Savior Notebook’ until the day she will die. Meeting in spring, checking out the summer fireworks, the cultural festival in fall, running away during the cold winter…

The more memories we built together, the easier I realized—that she was still just a normal girl. So could I, the strongest shadow user and hunter of humanity’s evil, possibly save her before it’s too late?
synonyms: Well, I'll be dead in one year

title.native: 私、救世主なんだ。まぁ、一年後には死んでるんだけどね
title.romaji: Watashi, Kyuuseishu Nanda. Maa, Ichinengo niwa Shideru ndakedo ne

150282.description: Lucie is a pretty French teenager with blonde hair and blue eyes who recently became my roommate and is always pampering me. But most of all, she's an inveterate otaku who has infinite respect for me as a video game designer!

title.native: ホームステイを受け入れたら、俺のことを全肯定してくれるオタク美少女だった
title.romaji: Homestay wo Ukeiretara, Ore no Koto wo Zen Koutei Shitekureru Otaku Bishoujo Datta

150283.description:
The story is set in the distant future, on a planet dominated by over-evolved machines. Humanity is on the brink of extinction, but the Church's selection of the Hero of Prophecy offers hope for expanding the sphere of existence.
Meanwhile, Lerin Cliffis, a young man who has dreamed of being a hero since he was a child, is an outstanding explorer recognised by all, but he is desperate because he is not named a hero. Lerin had lost his purpose in life, but he meets Ul, a mechanical girl who is supposed to be his enemy, and he learns a shocking truth. Ul knows that the human race will soon become extinct, and that only Lerin can save it!
Lerin starts working with her, but unimaginable difficulties await him...

title.native: ネームレス・レコード　Hey ウル、世界の救い方を教えて
title.romaji: Nameless Record: Hey Uru, Sekai no Sukuikata wo Oshiete

150284.description:
Park Si-on has the body of a 29-year-old and the mind of a 9-year-old; he is a savant who is on the autism spectrum. With his innate genius like two sides of the same coin, he enters a university hospital as a pediatric surgery resident. The prejudice of being a doctor with autism and the battle for power in the hospital gets more and more dangerous...! Will he ever be able to become a real doctor?

(Source: Naver, translated)

150285.description: The sci-fi survival manga is about three high school friends: Manatsu Kurashiki, a member of the school's Kendo club; Tsumugi Midorikawa, who streams live videos of insects; and Ayano Yamaji, who likes reading about occult topics and urban legends. The three friends fail their exam, and they have to attend a supplementary class on the first day of summer. During their supplementary class, a helicopter from the Self-Defense Force suddenly lands on the school ground. The soldiers explain to their teacher that the town is in lockdown due to a nano machine attack. The three friends watching everything from their classroom are in shock when they see their teacher suddenly getting devoured by a huge number of ants.

title.native: 精霊少女に『カッコいい俺』だけ見せていたら、いつの間にか最強になっていた
title.romaji: Seirei Shoujo ni "Kakkoii Ore" Dake Misete Itara, Itsunomanika Saikyou ni Natte Ita

150287.description:
The "Shiyue" ship was the #1 trending topic online, but nobody knew the true story behind the relationship between Bai Fangshi and Sheng Yue from three years ago.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Is the Scandalous Gossip My Fault?
title.romaji: Feiwen Tai Duo Shi Wo de Cuo ma

150288.description:
A new comedy story set in modern Japan following three high school girls bursting with personality.

Follow the everyday antics of three members of the Origami High School's Culinary Arts Club, Nana the super excitable blabbermouth, Yuka the quick-witted closet otaku, and Shino the studious mystery girl with a scary high IQ.

Whether it's bitter shopkeepers, Vtubers, shifty crime syndicates, ghosts, demons, or gods, come along for the ride and see how these three deal with everyday life. Club activities, part-time jobs, otaku activities, game streams, tests of courage, study sessions, and more await in this short story collection.
synonyms: 5 Seconds Left Until Nana Stirs Up Trouble

title.native: ナナがやらかす五秒前

150289.description:
My sister is the bride of a count and I'm to be his mistress?

"Your life in this family is so sad. You have to be bedded by a man you don't even love," Elliott whispered in Laurel's ear as he continued to take her night after night. He was a count who was engaged to Laurel's younger sister. However, her sister was in a relationship with another man. When Laurel covered for her, she ended up agreeing to become Elliott's mistress to keep his attention on her. Laurel must have her body and heart played with by him to repent for her sister's sin. She shouldn't enjoy it, but his intimate touches make Laurel feel almost as if he loves her...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: S系貴公子のお気に入り
見た目に反して（僕だけに）甘えたがりの幼なじみを、僕は毎日論破しなければならない。
title.romaji: Mitame ni Hanshite (Boku Dake ni) Amaeta Gari no Osananajimi wo, Boku wa Mainichi Ronpa Shinakereba Naranai.

150291.description:
Demon Lord Clayman was killed by Rimuru at Walpurgis. But, Clayman acquired the unique skill "Regressor" while on the verge of death and woke up in his room 70 years ago. Considering the situation, it appears that this it's actually real. Clayman begins to look for ways to avoid the same mistakes he has made in the past, butー

Will Clayman be able to avoid a doomed future by taking advantage of his loop?
synonyms: 전생했더니 슬라임이었던 건에 대하여 클레이만 REVENGE

title.english: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman's Revenge
title.native: 転生したらスライムだった件 クレイマンREVENGE
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Clayman REVENGE

150292.description:
Chisa's life recently has been difficult: the design company she works at went under and to top it off, her boyfriend cheated on her! To pull herself together, she decides to go back to her hometown. There, she is reunited with her childhood friend, Takumi, who currently works as a lifeguard and saves her from drowning yet again. From there, the two become more intimate with each other, though it seems Takumi is hiding something from Chisa that had something to do with the past when Chisa almost drowned.

(Source: Manga Planet)

title.native: 溺れるなら俺にしろ～幼馴染は肉食ライフセーバー～
title.romaji: Oboreru nara Ore ni Shiro - Osananajimi wa Nikushoku Lifesaver

150293.description:
"Teacher, I know your secret crush. It was my dad, wasn't it? If you want me to keep it a secret, then become my lover." That threat threw Ye Qing's life into chaos. When he was 19, Ye Qing had a crush on his private tutor. 18 years later, all those repressed feelings were revealed, and Ye Qing was forced to play a lovers game with his teacher's son. Despite their 18-year age gap, he felt powerless under the younger man's aggressive tactics.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150296.description:
He likes to bully my characters in video games… In real life, he likes… to bully me even more…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150297.description: A reaper and a human's love. And their crime.

title.native: その死神は人間に恋をしたんだ
title.romaji: Sono Shinigami wa Ningen ni Koi wo Shitanda

150299.description:
Lu Qi’an, I want you.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150300.description: Serialized as “Yagate Azaneheru” (軈て糾へる) in Comic Mate Legend (Vol.35 ~ 43)

150301.description:
1. Kanemochi Family → Nikkai Family (金持ちファミリー → 肉塊ファミリー); Ryona King Vol.16
2. Ai no Aru Seppuku (愛のある切腹); Ryona King Vol.15
3. SMELL LIKE…; Ryona King Vol.18
4. Dabustakko wa Wakariaenai (ダブスタっ子はわかりあえない); Ryona King Vol.17
5. Seppuku Haishin (切腹配信); Ryona King Vol.19
6. Imadoki!? Kubikarizoku (今ドキ！？ 首狩族); Ryona King Vol.11
7. Isekai ni Saku Ichirin no Hana (異世界に咲く一輪の腸); Ryona King Vol.10
8. Niku wo Funda Musume (肉を踏んだ娘); Ryona King Vol.3
9. Sex Shinai to Derarenai Heya (セックスしないと出られない部屋); Ryona King Vol.4
10. Kasou Genjitsu Ryonanie (仮想現実リョナニー); Ryona King Vol.2
synonyms: Isekai ni Saku Ichirin no Hana
これはちょっと違うと思う！

150305.description:
From the high seas to high society.

When the infamous pirate Rosetta gets poisoned to death, she wakes up in the body of noble lady Leah. Now, to avoid a second death, Rosetta must play the part of a noble and... get engaged?! But to whom? Could it be to the strange admiral who has suddenly come chasing after "Rosetta"?

(Source: Manta)

150306.description:
Collected Stories:
1. Gin no Mi wo Tabeta? (銀の実をたべた?)
2. Kisetsufuu ni Notte (季節風にのって)
3. Nagori no Natsu no (なごりの夏の)
4. Tanjou! (誕生!)

150307.description:
Collected Stories:
1. Hoshi ni Iku Kisha (星にいく汽車)
2. Natsuko no Ichinichi (夏子の一日)
3. 3-gatsu ni Nareba (3月になれば)
4. Dansei Shikkaku (男性失格)
5. Cabbage Choucho (きゃべつちょうちょ)

150308.description:
A common scene. A person dies, their soul sent to the great beyond. A goddess plucks it from the ether and offers a deal - she will send the soul to another world she has created. She will also bequeath the human with skills that are so powerful they could be considered cheats. The goddess only asks for one thing in return: that they use their special powers to save her world from destruction.

The soul is summoned to another world and given the powers of a demigod. And as power corrupts, so too do the summoned humans abuse their abilities for wanton greed and violence.

Zyzz is a slave of one such otherworlder, who voluntarily became his servant to search for his sister. Then one day, he meets Kaina, a woman who calls herself the “final summon”, hand-picked by the goddess to slay those who have reneged on their promises…

title.native: チートイーター異世界召喚尽く滅ぶべし
title.romaji: Cheat Eater Isekai Shoukan Kotogotoku Horobubeshi

150309.description:
Insanity lurks within those walls...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2022-07

150310.description:
Trapped in the online game 'the Phantom Realm', Xia Ya has experienced 177 rounds of reboots and testing, conquering all the beautiful female NPCs, including the village girl, church priestess, dark elf queen candidate, and valkyrie chosen by the gods. After defeating all the BOSSes and clearing the game in over a hundred ways, 'the Phantom Realm' is finally open to the public! As more players join in, the once-static NPCs begin to change, and Xia Ya is determined to find a way out of the game during its public test...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Trapped Inside the Beta Server for 1,000 Years
title.native: 我被困在内测服一千年
title.romaji: Wo Bei Kun Zai Nei Ce Fu Yi Qian Nian

150311.description:
Zhao Youwei is a girl who's always been worried about her masculine name. All of a sudden, her childhood friend, who had just come back from abroad, proposes to her when he realizes that she is a girl! Liang Miaoyu did that because she bullied him when they were young, which caused him to be traumatized when being in close contact with others. Moreover, Zhao Youwei can't reject his proposal! What a disaster!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Contract Marriage: I Married My Cunning Childhood Friend
title.native: 契约婚约的竹马太腹黑
title.romaji: Qiyue Hunyue De Zhuma Tai Fuhei

150315.description:
Su-Cheol has a crush on his math teacher. His feelings for her aren't the innocent kind of love a student could have for his teacher..His meticulous and premeditated plan to make her fall for him begins!

"My Teacher.. She's my girl."

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: 先生の秘められた私性活

150316.description:
When you’re a short track speed skater, every second counts. But despite training 24-7, Hoonjae is no match for his arch rival Seojoon. What’s more, with practice taking up all his time, Hoonjae hasn’t been able to explore life’s pleasures - like girls, for instance. One night, he decides to take the plunge and lose his virginity. Once he does, he starts flying across the ice! Plus, all the gorgeous girls around the rink suddenly see Hoonjae in a different light. Soon enough, things begin to get hot and steamy off the ice…

(Source: Lezhin X)

150317.description:
After being kicked out of his house, Ju-Yung finds a job by the beach making tofu. But the problem is… That the owner and her two daughters are just too hot! “Why am I getting hard making tofu?!”

(Source: TOPTOON+)

150318.description:
Lee Giho is trying to earn his tuition through the popular VR game Circuit, but things just aren't going his way. However, right when he decides to throw in the towel, he gets a lucky break that changes everything. Fortune leads him ever deeper into the game’s lore, and before he knows it, Giho finds himself stocked up with powerful items chasing an elusive group of mysterious warriors. But to unlock his true powers, Giho must learn the secrets of this group before his luck runs out for good.

(Source: Tapas)

150319.description:
After being sealed away for 1,000 years, the War God Duan Yuxian has come back to a world that has forgotten him and his malevolent past. As he wanders aimlessly through the central plains ruled by the martial world, he comes across a dying little girl named Xiaomei and revives her out of pity. Although they try to live in peace as a family, the factions of the martial world refuse to let them be. Now, Duan Yuxian has no other choice but to remind them that the War God has truly returned.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Chronicles Of The Martial God’s Return

150320.description:
A young mafia murder in a foreign city. While the conflict between the organizations is suspected, a strange detective and a hard-armed assistant duo challenge the mysterious case.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: アップサイド・ダウンタウン

150321.description:
Ever since changing his WIFI password, a strange video started playing on his TV...

"Who's that? Is my TV paired with someone else's?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

150322.description:
Wataru Sumiyoshi was eager to take on his new assignment as the manager of a struggling family restaurant.

But his head waitress was a college girl named Urara who was all about making things easy for herself. She was determined to use her sex appeal to keep him from doing any serious work.

Will the manager's career success be achieved?......!

(Source: Manga Time Comics, translated)

150326.description:
The Crippled General Lu Ji X Substitude Bride Merman, Yu Xiaoman

My name is Yu Xiaoman. My surname, "Yu", comes from Yujia Village, the place where you saved me; My given name is from the solar term of the day you saved me seven years ago, and also the day we first met. This is the story of Yu Xiaoman, the little merman who wanted to repay his savior's kindness and offered himself as a substitute bride in his marriage.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150327.description:
I, Shen Jiang, an unknown, simple-minded thief, somehow became the princess of the Wei Empire! I'm not a princess! More importantly, I'm a man! What is this? And I have to marry the regent, Xiao, also known as the soldier of the night!!! Wait, he's a man too, right?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The World Isn’t as Beautiful as You

150328.description:
The eccentric genius artist Fu Nian and the college lecturer Su Qiusheng suddenly find their realities overlapping. From then on, they're forced into a chaotic life of "cohabitation".

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150329.description:
After being strangled to death, Lin Yaxi wakes up to find herself back to five years ago - just an hour before the car accident which would change her fate. Bearing a grudge against her evil sister and scumbag fiancé, she swears to never let history repeat itself. However, her fiancé's brother, Chen Yi - a two-faced man, seems to be paying extra attention to her...

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Rebirth Begins With Refusal Of Marriage

150330.description:
As ordinary people lost faith in the traditional gods, the Heavenly Court began to deteriorate. So the Jade Emperor of Heaven decided to open up a new tenth level of heaven dedicated to the new department known as the Frugality And Revitalization Department! The "Holiday Gods" gathered there, trying to come up with ideas to get people excited about the traditional holidays and increase their faith again... But the gods don't seem to understand what's going on in the modern world these days?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Sui Shi Ling Zhi Guang Yuan Tian

150331.description:
Shy and sedulous Dominant Omega Aster was left alone during his heat cycle by his careless boyfriend. Just when he can no longer take the adverse symptoms of his heat cycle, Mr. Xin – his aloof Dominant Alpha boss comes to his rescue by remarking him... How will the two deal with their complicated relationship?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue and four bonus chapters.

150332.description:
A system suddenly appeared in Zhan Weiyang’s mind and started assigning him missions. The system wants him to get together with the first person that he meets on the first day of the new semester at school. He found a target at random and started working on an impossible mission. Meanwhile, Pei Qing, Weiyang’s cousin who is staying over at his place, finds it amusing that his cousin does not seem to be very bright.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150333.description:
Sentinel: Hey, you know what? I got here through reincarnation.
Guide: Oh... it was transmigration for me. We're in the fictional world of a novel where you're the villain, and I'm the cannon fodder. Here, have a look.
Sentinel: (Skimming through) Oh, so that's how my second life ended... Psh, Planet X's rebels were utter trash, and Y Nation's government was so weak. Did the leader of Planet Z's bandit gang go soft in the head? How could he become traitor for the sake of love?
Guide: You've been reincarnated more than once? Wow!
Sentinel: Yeah, I'm in my third lifetime now. I never thought I'd get reincarnated again and be lucky enough to meet you...
Guide: So what if you meet me?
Sentinel: Now that I've met you, you've inspired me... to clean up my act.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150335.description:
"100 days left, and I'm still a virgin"

Kun-Hee is a 21-year-old university student. He has a girlfriend but is still a virgin because her, Goo-I, said that she will be a virgin until marriage. Instead of a girlfriend showing no sign of permission, a tempting offer comes to Kun-Hee, in a hurry before enlistment...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

150336.description:
Hi, I'm a cartoonist. I meet one of my old art students and she wants to be my assistant. What does she want to assist me with?

(Source: Toomics)

150337.description:
What happens when a man meets three women who need money?

(Source: Toomics)

150338.description:
Not even a year after my mom died, my dad found a new woman. I hated her, but I also wanted to fuck her. Is this normal? And now that my dad ran off after his business failed, it's just the two of us now

(Source: DAYcomics)

150339.description:
You can become desperate when revenge is on your mind. Will Lily be able to use her desperation to succeed?

(Source: Toomics)

150341.description:
The year is 203X, and Earth is under attack. The enemy? Extraterrestrials. Park Hyunsung, a militia commander, valiantly lays down his life to take down the enemy base. One moment, he’s caught up in a malfunctioning teleportation device; the next… he’s in the body of Ian Alberon, a 15-year-old lord! Thrown into a world of monsters and magic, Hyunsung — now Ian — must figure out how to navigate his new surroundings. And to top it all off, it seems his enemies may be much closer than he thinks…

(Source: Tapas)

Gildong is a country boy that needs some fresh inspiration. He has aspirations of becoming a famous comic artist but he wants to draw women and the only ones he knows are his mom and grandma. He has a solution in mind, however. Move to Seoul, the land of opportunity, where voluptuous and scantily clad “inspiration” abounds! No more old ladies and nights alone. A new life awaits the bright-eyed and bushy-tailed pushover from the boonies when he starts fresh in the big city!

(Source: Lezhin X)
