150344.description:
Jung Daeman leads a double life. On the outside, he’s the adopted son of a rich and beautiful family, but behind closed doors he’s little more than their servant. Only one of his “sisters” is ever nice to him, and the rest of them work him like a dog! Things only start to change when the head of the house, Mr. Kim, comes back from a business trip, and makes it clear that he thinks of Daeman as his son and tells his wife and daughters to be nicer to Daeman. The thing is, while he might want them all to be closer, surely he didn’t mean this close?!

(Source: Lezhin X)

150345.description:
Si-Hu’s life is a pretty good one. He’s starting a new job at a pretty decent company, he’s been happily married to a gorgeous wife for six years, and he’s pretty good-looking himself. But one day, everything starts cracking at the edges when he starts to suspect that his beautiful wife Si-A is having an affair. He can’t stop obsessing and worrying over it, but his pretty coworker Min-A might have the perfect solution: a steamy affair of his own. Si-Hu isn’t sure this is the right thing to do, but it’s hard to say no when his wife is more suspicious than ever and there so many gorgeous women at his office. So maybe a little infidelity can’t hurt…right?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

She was love with her childhood friend Ace, but she's now crazy about her female teacher, Alicia. Alicia is beautiful, kind, enthusiastic, and also a free mind, and Jill's feelings for Alicia went beyond aspirational and are now closer to love. Meanwhile, Jill's best friends Marge and Kathryn all fall in love with Jill's older brother Graham...

(Source: Beaglee, translated)

London, a city where demons and angels live in harmony. The problem begins when 3 men, Vales, Ralph, and Moira, invade London. Monsters who are killed one after another. The Asmodian youth Amon, the blind Girl Clausel, the cat girl Phil, and the unidentified man Captain stand up to save their comrades! In the fierce battle between humans and monsters, the true purpose of the three characters finally becomes clear!! Can a monster stop a human conspiracy?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

The remains of a pair of men and women who sank to the bottom of the sea. That was one of the consequences of the Kinki upheaval that engulfed the whole of Japan and triggered the division of east and west. It's been 13 years since. The delicate peace, which was maintained between the east and the west, seemed on the verge of collapsing again. IXOLDE, a sacred treasure and strong artefact, was regenerated in the Osaka area. In order to prevent the launch of the artefact, Hidehisa Nakamura, the preseident of the Tokyo area invaded the neutral Nagoya area together with citizens of Zenon City. Why would Osaka regenerate one of the strongest sacred treasures? A new war between east and west Japan begins in Osaka!

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

150376.description:
As the empress, Alexandra should be the most respected woman in the empire. She did everything she could, even sacrificing her own parents to make her husband the emperor. But instead of showering her with gratitude and love, Kleio repays her by framing her and sentencing her to death. So in the split second before her unfair demise, Alexandra offers up a prayer to God. Next thing she knows, she's opening her eyes six years in the past on the day she married Kleio. Alexandra's prayer has been answered, and now... it's time for revenge.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: A Villainess' Revenge Is Sweeter Than Honey

synonyms: 鉄人28号 鉄人奪還作戦

150378.description:
Gokurakugai, a bright and bustling working class district with a hidden dark side. In this area without order, Tao and Alma work as troubleshooters for hire. Their missions involve helping a young boy find his lost friend, a person who dissapears without a trace, and disfigured animal corpses. All the while, the evil spirits who live in the shadows bring out a different side to these troubleshooters!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

150379.description:
Politician's son Chiaki Nagayama really isn't up to pulling the same power plays his father is best known for, not when he doesn't seem to have enough greed in him to yearn for success. But that just might change after a night with his father's scholar...

(Source: Futekiya)

The maritime nation "Republic of Enetia" where the plague "black disease" has begun to spread. In this country, there was a "state affairs assassin" who executed a felony, commonly known as an assassin of justice.

Gatto inspires to become a great state-approved assassin. One day, while he is scolded for failing to neutralize a target, his colleague gets killed and turned into a puppet in front of his very eyes... This event leads him to meet a strange individual that claims they are a god of death.

150381.description:
Yuuko is an average 5th grader from the late 1960s whose friend gives her a brown tabby kitten. She names her Tiger. Yuuko and Tiger grow up together, although Tiger is, of course, much quicker to mature. From 1967 to 1970, Yuuko goes through a formative four years from childhood to young adulthood where she learns about time and space travel, sports, and... where babies come from! Just wait till she tells Tiger about this! What Yuuko doesn't know, however, is that Tiger understands everything she is saying and looks after her more than she will ever realize...

(Source: Manga Planet)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

I’ve transmigrated into this loser emperor’s body, and I even have to stick to the script and follow the storyline. Sh*t, the storyline wants me to bring the handsome general into the harem to humiliate him?! This… this can’t be good…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150384.description:
A Xue, an unsuccessful artist whose manhua was about to be axed, transmigrated into the world of his own manhua by chance. In his comic, the Pandora Continent was on the verge of destruction due to the growing power of the Demon Lord, which put A Xue in danger as well. Facing imminent doom, A Xue was given a second chance at survival, with the condition that he takes over the hero’s role from the beginning and redo the entire story. If he fails to "create" a more interesting story-line, then A Xue and the entire world will be destroyed…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150385.description:
Yan Yi is an exceptional omega, possessing a rare tier-3 gland cell. But when it comes to compatibility, numbers are everything, and his compatibility with the alpha Lu Shangjin is too low a percentage. Eventually bored with Yan, the alpha removes his mark and breaks their bond, but Yan Yi never stops loving him. So when Shangjin finds an omega with more compatible glands, the choice to undergo a risky transplant surgery seems obvious, but will it be enough to restore the love they once shared?

(Source: Tapas)

150386.description:
After taking revenge on her abusive ex-boyfriend, she died and transmigrated into the heroine of the popular otome game "Rose Spiral". She found out that all the men in the game had bad intentions, and pursued the female lead only to use her for their own purposes. The cold heart of the reborn girl burned with hatred, and a plan for revenge slowly unfolded. Even as she schemed and seduced these men, will she ever learn to love and be loved again?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150387.description:
Gao Miaomiao was finally going to meet her online friend after chatting for more than a year. When she found Pu Xu at the meeting spot holding the sign, she never expected him to be so different from his gentle and easy-going online personality. She wanted to stay away from that cold and distant Pu Xu, but when they had to cooperate for a school assignment, she slowly realized the shining qualities of this diamond in the rough, as they helped each other to resolve the issues hidden deep in their hearts.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150388.description:
Seiichi Ito's wife asked for divorce, saying, "You are useless for raising kids."
In a panic, he fell down and woke up to find that he was in the body of his wife, having just given birth to Ko-chan!
"Ko-chan will be fine!" "Just relax!" "What should I do?"
......He thought he was helping with child-rearing in his own way before, but it turned out he didn't understand anything...?
Seiichi, clumsily but clumsily, began to raise his child in his wife's body while being frustrated with his carefree original "self." Will he ever be able to get back to his ideal "family of three" life?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Ling Lin is a girl with terrible luck, who can't seem to do anything right. Until she went to college, met the beautiful and kind senpai Fang Wan, and fell for her before she knew it. In this vast universe, there is someone out there connected to you, who will make sure you will never be alone.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150392.description:
Elena, a noble's daughter, remembers the memories of her previous life and thinks about her long-cherished desire to work in the fields. But every day she is opposed by both her father and fiancée.
One day, as she rushes out of her house to see her farm, she meets Prince Lewis, who changes her destiny, and her new life begins ...!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

150394.description:
Duan Weiying transmigrated into the body of a new concubine on a harem mission. Her goal was suppose to beat out all the other girls to become the Emperor's favorite. But she had no interest in some unfaithful playboy Emperor, and she was going to just go through the motions and abuse her cheats to finish her assignment. That was until she found out the Emperor was actually a cool, beautiful Empress, who fell in love with Duan Weiying at first sight. Now both are caught up in each other…

She swore to bring down all those who have wronged her, so she pretended to be dumb and mute, embarking on the path of crushing her antagonists to overturn her fate!

Namsae, since middle school has always been ostracized by her classmates, her desire only wants to be recognized and loved by those around her. But when she was in high school she found a lucky coin that changed her life. Juri, the living doll, is also rich, which is 180 degrees different from being part of her life. Is it true that the coin is really a lucky coin? Whose is it and where did the coin come from? And will Namsae's fate be different from her middle school days and find the meaning of friendship and being recognized by others for her existence?

By order of the Sanctum, an international peacekeeping agency, Ral and Jilet cross many nations to edit the Pamphlet, a collection of regional myths and stories. On the day of her execution, Vyaria wakes up to find time has reversed itself, making her seven years old again. Thinking of the events of her future, she is truly traumatized. Her first marriage to King Cain had been a cold and unhappy one. Each time she made an attempt to get closer to him, she had been faced with rejection, and the sudden appearance of a girl from another dimension had only increased Cain's hostility towards Vyaria. Behind her back, everyone had called her the “Princess of Blue Roses,” after the flower that symbolizes unattainable wishes.

Knowing she would eventually be sentenced to death by her own husband, Vyaria is terrified when she is once again united with the young Cain. Is everything going to repeat itself? Is there really nothing she could do to change the future?

As scared as she is, Vyaria vows to fight against her cruel fate in this second chance at life…!

Think of me whenever the flowers bloom. Eungtae, a man destined to die young. Yeon, a woman whose childhood was cursed by the heavens. On a precious summer day beneath the blossoms of the trumpet vine, the two fall in love as fate intended. And in an instant, a shadow is cast over their future.

Born in Japan and raised as a human, Taiki is overwhelmed when he's brought back to the kingdom of Tai, where he's told he's a kirin. With little knowledge or guidance, he must trust his latent instincts to choose a king for the Kingdom of Tai from among dozens of men and women who seek the position. Will the frustrated Taiki, who can't even figure out how to transform into animal form, make the right choice? And more important, will he discover the kirin that lives within?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

150533.description:
When only an eggfruit, the kirin of the En Kingdom, Rokuta, was transported to Japan for his own protection. But he was abandoned soon after birth by his surrogate parents, left to fend for himself in the mountains. It just so happened that at the same time, a young boy in the En Kingdom named Koya was also abandoned by his own parents, after which he was raised by demon beasts. Their similar circumstances aren't the only thing to bind these two boys, though. Twenty years after their abandonment, their destinies intersect, with potentially disaster consequences for the En Kingdom.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

However, when Enho is kidnapped, Yoko finds herself thrust into an all-out war between the kingdoms. Friendships and alliances are put to the test during the Battle of Wa Province. Can Yoko summon the strength to take up her responsibilities as king?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

The kingdom of Kyou has been without a ruler for twenty-seven long years. Now Youma run rampant across the lands. Shushou, the twelve-year-old daughter of a wealthy merchant lives a sheltered and pampered life in the capital city of Renshou, but the more she learns about the plights of those less fortunate, the more frustrated she grows. She’s left with a decision that shall change the fate of her kingdom. If the adults are unwilling to journey to Mount Hou and present themselves before the Kirin as the land’s new ruler, then why not her?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

150536.description:
Six months after King Hyonjong ascended to the throne, the Dai Kingdom was on its way to revival. However, the king, who had gone to suppress a rebellion, did not return, and Taiki disappeared without a trace. The female general Yi Sai, worried about the loss of the king and the kirin, goes to Gyeongguk, risking her life to ask for help.

150537.description:
There are as many definitions of monarchy as there are birds in the sky. Some take the throne to become tyrants, whiling their days away in a reverie of unearned privilege. Others bleed to quench the people’s thirst. These stories of kings and queens introduce new conflicts across The Twelve Kingdoms and tie up the loose ends of past tales. The kingdom of Sai is in peril after its Kirin falls ill in Prosperity. Taiki embarks on a journey to offer gratitude in Winter Glory. And Youko reaches out to her dearest friend, Rakushun, in Letters.

Five short stories about rulers, their ideals, and their troubles.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

150538.description:
The Twelve Kingdoms are often defined by the destinies of kings, queens, and beasts beyond imagination. However, there are many people whose lives are shaken by these decisions who never seek the spotlight. In The Birds of Hisho, a potter struggles with the weight of responsibility that comes with creating a ceramic bird for a ritual as part of Youko’s coronation. But with his grievous past plaguing his mind, can the artist bring himself to create a bird that truly represents hope?

Four short stories detail the lives of everyday people within The Twelve Kingdoms and their struggles to fulfill their places in the world.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

In ancient times, it was said that humans and demons lived in harmony, and could even have children together. Those children will bear the mark of their ancestry. Xue Feng's mother was brutally murdered by a demon. What he didn't know was that he was himself an experimental subject of the demonic sect, trying to resurrect demonic beasts. After Xue Feng was saved, he was somehow recruited into Xuanjingsi, established by the Imperial Court to be the ultimate authority of the land.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated).

150603.description:
The bad guy Luo Jianqing was slain by the hero! After being reborn, he will take up the script and the sword, and he was on his way to defeat the hero and win the throne. Furthermore, he's going to make his haughty master into his plaything, too!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: The Villain Has Something to Say (Rebirth)

150604.description:
The zombie virus spread throughout the world and caused the end of days. Ye Bei was tricked by his classmate and lost his arm to a zombie. He had to hide away like a cockroach for 50 years to survive. During that time, he managed to build a time machine and returned himself to 50 years ago, before the apocalypse, with the chance to relive his life. Having seen how people acted during the crisis, he swore he'll be more devious, more selfish, and more coldhearted than anyone else. The first thing he'll do, he's going to feed that bitch to the zombies!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150605.description: Driven by his childhood dreams, Shunpei wanted to become a screenwriter. However, neither his friends nor his family expected him to succeed. Out of high school, he left home soaring into the unknown, with the sole ambition of telling the most beautiful story.

150607.description:
Cui Zuofei accidentally drowned and died. In the underworld, he met Jiushu, who taught him the Sanqing Tome, and he became an disciple of the Sanqing techniques. He was able to return to life and got a job with a fortune teller, where he met another Sanqing disciple Yi Xinxing. The two got along well, and they decided to strike out on their own to slay demons and fight evil, in a series of stirring adventures.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A marriage of convenience has turned two people into mere sacrifices. In the face of a mistress' provocation and the special attention of her best friend's brother, Lu Nanyin was forced to fight with everything she has while still playing the part of "the perfect Mrs. Gu." Meanwhile, Gu Xiaocheng resented the forced marriage to Lu Nanyin, but he couldn't help falling in love with her along the way...

150615.description:
The servant of God, Saharo, breaks the biggest rule for an angel when she momentarily sympathizes with Evil. After letting Evil escape from heaven’s grasp, Saharo loses her angelic wings and won’t be able to reascend until she destroys the dark enemy once and for all. There’s just one problem: her target is reincarnated as a human boy named Yannick Unbrey. While angels have the power to eliminate Evil, they are forbidden from ever killing a human being. Thus, Saharo’s only choice is to watch over the boy and make sure the darkness within him never awakens. But the older Yannick gets, the more he becomes tainted by the wicked nature of the world. Will Saharo be able to protect Yannick from his slumbering demon, or will she end up giving in to its sinful call with him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

My big master is 100cm taller than me, and an adorable gentle giant! Hinata, a boy who dreams of wielding magic, becomes the apprentice of Esmeralda, a witch towering at 240cm tall. What begins as instruction in the magical arts is slowly twisted into something more by Esmeralda's affection for Hinata. Is this a teacher's platonic love for her pupil? Or something more?!

While bathing in a hot spring Runa Hatagami is mistakenly transferred to another world as a hero in a towel... Moreover, the goddess only gave her a weird "Hot Spring" skill and a high defensive power? She managed to get a bath towel with her skill, but she was still almost completely naked...

Furthermore, she was put under a certain "curse" by a witch who is planning to resurrect the Demon King... The situation makes it impossible for her to return to her original world?!

150633.description:
Gaku Mashio was a first-year high school student who lived with his father. He lost his father in a sudden accident, just as he got suspended from school after getting into a fight. On the night of his father's wake, Gaku went fishing on the shore in memory of his father, but he fell into the sea and was returned 22 years into the past. Gaku's father, Harumi, who was the same age as Gaku at that time, saved him from the water. Harumi's parents (Gaku's grandparents) took a liking to Gaku, and accepted him into their family under the name Gaku Miyagi. His grandparents even encouraged him to go to Seiha High School, same as his father. Twenty-two years ago, the town of Kurei was full of delinquents. Now Gaku and his father will fight their way to the top of the town!

(Source: Shonen Champion, translated)

150641.description:
Kanon Kusakabe endured relentless bullying in her previous life, only to find herself reborn as Flora, the villainess from the popular Otome dating sim game “Path of Love.” For six peaceful years, she lived happily as Flora, cherishing her loving and admirable parents. But that tranquility was short-lived when a crisis emerged that would mark the beginning of her gentle mother’s downfall. Just because she’s labeled the villain doesn’t mean she has to die! Determined to protect her family and avoid those ominous death flags, Kanon takes action. However, no matter what she does, the game’s love interests keep getting drawn to her…

(Source: Emaqi)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

150645.description: After being accepted into college, Kazumi starts his college life by living with his distant relatives. He had to succeed in college for his grandmother who raised him by herself. What he finds out when he gets to the new house is that he will have to live with 4 girls, each seeking to win his heart. Will he be able to concentrate on his schooling with four girls constantly all over him?

まひろちゃんのおてつだい

150651.description: Dan was “the strongest and bravest” when he was young. But because of his lazy life, he is now a divorced, unemployed old man! He tries to earn money through quests for a living, but age has taken its toll on his strength and all that! He was approached by a silver-haired elf, a handsome man, and an S-rank adventurer… a young man of today’s generation!
synonyms: Re-Employment of the Former Strongest Hero

150655.description:
While still in the flirting phase, it's easy to think too much and cause hilarious misunderstandings! The beautiful Xiangcao, who is deathly afraid of the water, meets the shy and gentle boy Dongcheng. What kind of romantic story will be woven between them?

(Source: WEBTOON, translated)

150658.description:
Tsukimichi Dori, 15 years old. "Escaping" is his specialty. Case in point, he escaped his hometown in Tokyo by enrolling at a high school in Kyoto. But a mysterious, inverted world where a battle for supremacy using "irezumi" tattoos called "Bokusenkon" rages, was waiting for him! Tsukimichi's horribly awesome high school days are about to being...!!

From the duo that penned "Deadman Wonderland," here comes a coming-of-age story with heart-pounding action, tattoos, and all the splendor of Kyoto!

(Source: K-Manga)

150660.description:
Kisa, who works hard at the family business, is a country girl that has never once been in love. One day, Amane, a young CEO who is the descendant of an old noble family, visits her family home on business and suddenly proposes to her. "I'd like to marry you." When Kisa asks why, he confuses her even more by simply stating, "I can just feel it." Eventually, his straightforward words win over her heart, and she agrees to live together with the premise of marriage. Despite his cool and collected exterior, his sweet and gentle actions bring them closer, but their new life together may encounter more trouble than expected...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Five years ago, the star designer An Zhisu was framed to be the perpetrator in an accident. Five years later, starting from scratch and completely on her own, will she redress her grievances and return to the fashion stage where she belongs?

150663.description:
What happens after the story ends with a “happily ever after”? When Hestia enters her favorite novel as a side character, she happily fangirls from the sidelines. Thinking she’ll return home when the story reaches its end, Hestia finds that the only thing awaiting her is the tragic death of her favorite character. Now miraculously restored to the day of the ending, Hestia decides that she’ll no longer spectate from the sidelines – instead, she’ll save her derelict favorite!

(Source: WEBTOON)

150664.description:
Ji-Min’s new goal in life is to get her hands on her crush’s underwear, but not for the reason you might think! She has been advised by her fortune teller that she’ll have a chance with him if she manages to stick a charm on his underwear. But how’s she supposed to do that when even just looking at him makes her tongue-tied? Luckily, Ji-Min has a plan, but will things go the way she wants, or will she end up making her crush hate her before she even gets a chance to use the charm?

(Source: WEBTOON)

150666.description: In the future, mankind began its expansion by developing space colonies aboard gigantic stations. One of them, called "Marco Polo", has recently housed a man named Romero Danceking who came here in search of a book containing nearly four thousand years of knowledge, it is said that this book will give its owner the power to give birth to a god...

When the son of the Samsa family doesn't wake up on time one morning, his father starts to worry... Usually very square, and an exceptional salesman, his son has never failed to show up. However, that morning, something is wrong... Behind the locked door, an unusual voice is heard. What happened to Gregor during the night?

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

title.native: Welcome Sashachang サーシャちゃんがようこそ

150671.description: Kim lives a peaceful life with his father as a farmer, until one day a runaway spaceship is detected moving at high speed towards her father's farm. To save him, Kim jumps aboard the ship and manages to land it safely before it crashes. Aboard the ship, he finds a badly injured lone survivor who, with his dying words, begs Kim to bring something to the galactic fleet. He transfer something from his arm to Kim's arm that made Kim a 'Lensman'. Apart from giving Kim unknown powers, it also contains vital information for the Galactic Fleet's victory over the evil Boskone Empire. Kim must now use the Britannia spacecraft to bring the Lense to the Galactic Fleet. But it's no easy task when Lord Helmet of the Boskone Empire is ready to use everything in his power to stop him.

150677.description:
Cooking in summer is really hard labor. Whether you’re going to buy ingredients, doing something in front of a fire, or even dipping your hands in cold water and washing dishes, you’re sweating. It’s hard to eat and even have a fever in your body.
However, the chef at the restaurant who arrived in the heat of the day said, “You can’t starve,” and she was introduced by a friend. Why do you feel like you’re in a relationship now? Can I start a new relationship?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

150678.description:
The problem with the handsome college student Kei Tachibana, is that his cute, older girlfriend Chisa is crazy about other men. What's worse is that these men are her favorite 2D characters. How will Kei-kun struggle every day to make Chisa care more about him than those blasted husbandos?

This is a love comedy between a devoted younger boy and an otaku working woman!

(Source: Manga Mee, translated)

150679.description:
In a little mysterious world where dragon people that sometimes transform into dragons live together with humans, a boy's childhood dragon girl friend is supposed to move to the dragon's city when she turns 17... This is a heartwarming love story between a dragon and a human!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

Note: This is the result of a contest where people could submit manga storyboards made with Jump's World Maker app, with the winners getting their idea professionally illustrated.

"Every person is the protagonist of his or her own life. But how many of us can truly live. How many of us can truly be the hero of our own lives?" Youth Protagonist.

This is a love story about a high school boy who thinks he is incapable of love for one reason or another, and a girl classmate who falls in love with him.

150684.description:
Yuma was an ordinary college student who was suddenly summoned to another world. Like the typical isekai protagonist, he was given powerful cheat-abilities, so he thought he was about to begin a fun life in the new world, but what awaited him was a cold and cruel treatment. He was captured, his body mutilated, as fear and intense pain ran through his body. And he was not even allowed to die, for despite Yuma's heartrending cries, his "immortality" ability continued to regenerate his body. Yuma was reduced to an experimental animal by the researchers who were fascinated by its potential. Finally his life began to change for the better when he met Eva, a beautiful girl also being kept in the facility!

(Source: Comic Regalia, translated) Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)
synonyms: My Companion Is the Strongest Undead in Another World

150685.description:
Sousuke Kaburaya, an impoverished detective, met Sara, a princess from another world with magical powers.

Sara began living with Sousuke, and she quickly adjusted to life in modern Japan.
Meanwhile, Livia, a female knight who came from the same world as Sara, found herself lost and homeless, but surprisingly enjoyed her days here.

These two people, who live a positive life despite their situation, began to have an impact on Sousuke and the other oddballs in the neighborhood, including a devilish lawyer, a divorce agent, and a cult leader.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

150686.description:
Paris Kameyama of the Kamematsu Family steals Helen, the wife of a captain of the Akaiya Clan, after meeting her at a party. Enraged, the Akaiya summons Achilles, a man known as "the Demigod", to hunt Paris down...

An outlaw hero epic begins!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

150689.description:
In April 2022, the Civil Code was changed to lower the age of majority for men and women from 20 to 18. This is the lovable newlywed life of a couple of high school seniors who got married the "fastest" after the age change came into effect.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

150690.description: The morning after a heavy snowfall, Yu Hirose was knocked down by an icy downhill car after staying up all night on his way home. When he wakes up, he is surprised to find that he has been reborn as a different person: an extremely good-looking boy with the same last name as him. Furthermore, the world has a unbalanced ratio of men and women, with women taking the lead role in society, and fewer men where it's natural for them to be protected. There are women who have too much sexual desire and want men, and men who are afraid of women and are on the defensive. Yuu's new school life begins in a world where chastity has been reversed.
synonyms: I've Reincarnated into a World of Reverse Chasticy

150693.description:
When Ai's ex-boyfriend broke up with him with the notion Ai didn't really love him, Ai was left devastated and at a loss. In his time of sadness, he meets Michi, a café manager who offered a helping hand and brought cheer to Ai's depressed state. Ai falls for Michi, who's also gay and currently single in no time. Ai often daydreams of Michi topping him and took the courage to confess to him but was rejected. Still in love with Michi, Ai pursues Michi until the latter relents. It turns out, Michi is not as dominant as he looks.

(Source: Futekiya)

150699.description:
This is the story of a detestable Demon Lord and his wonderful new wife, a destitute damsel! Our Demon Lord, Anima, is the strongest in all the world, feared by the denizens of the realm. He's forced to spend his days in solitude until, completely out of the blue, he gets summoned to another world! The one who summons him is none other than Luina, an exceedingly poor girl who runs an orphanage. The two of them quickly fall in love, with Anima swearing to use his power to protect his newfound family!

(Source: Sol Press)

150701.description:
L.A.G, an unknown space where humans use abilities or skills through awakening, monsters appear on each floor and room, and missions are given accordingly.

The goal here is to reach the bottom. The protagonist repeats death and life countless times in the unknown space L.A.G. However, in this life, he has the ability to own unlimited passive skills and finally has a chance to escape there.

However, unlike what he has been through so far, he will not know an inch of the future as L.A.G continues to change. This is a desperate survival story in which no one can be trusted and continues to survive the hellish L.A.G, where there is no end in sight, and fights for escape from the bottom.

150702.description:
Chu Zheng was bound to the money-squandering system by accident and traveled to another world. She'd die unless she squandered money there. Her missions were to spend money, to avenge on those who used to be bad to her, and even to make sure the innocent hero was healthy both physically and mentally. All this drove Chu Zheng crazy—She'd never heard of such missions... But there was nothing she could do with the powerful system. Therefore, by completing those missions, she proved a truth to us: Becoming a boss in another world starts with spending money!

(Source: Webnovel)

150705.description:
Mao finds himself falling in love at first sight with a photograph of a model named Kei. The only place where Mao can find Kei is at an art exhibition of the mysterious photographer named Mel.
While Mao is entranced by a photo of Kei at the art exhibition, someone at the exhibit asks to photograph Mao! Who is it if not the mysterious photographer Mel himself! Before he realizes it, Mao is in bed with Mel and is drowning in pleasure as Mel whispers to him "If you can be a good boy, I'll let you meet Kei."
Somehow this chance encounter leads to a situation where Mao is having sex with Kei as Mel takes pictures...?!

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

150707.description: Kim Seon-Ju, the genius CEO of a large company, was murdered in a mountainous area. However, his soul had entered into his smartphone! On the same day, Park In-Seong, who was looking for rare mushrooms to make money, accidentally found a strange smartphone. The strange smartphone that possessed by Kim Seon-Ju's soul then said, "If you will help me to find the killer, I will give you 10 billion!"

150708.description: The story is a prequel to the Mobile Fighter G Gundam TV anime series, taking place during the 7th Gundam Fight, 24 years before the events of the anime. It features Master Asia piloting the GF7-013NJ Yamato Gundam, representing Neo Japan. It also showcases how he became known as the King of Hearts, as well as his work as part of the Shuffle Alliance.

Based on Capcom's videogame.
In the year 2026, Metro City is at the mercy of a vicious gang of super-criminals, lead by the villainous Lord Scumocide. Only one fighting force can prevent total catastrophe by standing up to these mutant maniacs - the Commando Team! GINZU - the Ninja Commando! MACK - the Mummy Commando! BABY HEAD - the Baby Commando! And, of course, the man himself, CAPTAIN COMMANDO – the greatest hero of all time!

150737.description:
Jun is an intelligent and resourceful girl who spends her time creating all kinds of inventions. She creates a robot, Kichinosuke, who follows her everywhere and becomes her close friend.
She falls in love with Zero, a motorcycle enthusiast who prefers to travel the roads rather than study. Their mutual love of mechanical objects brings them closer together and Jun is determined to have Zero as her boyfriend. Unfortunately for Jun, he doesn’t even seem to notice her feelings!

150738.description: To carry out his missions, private detective Kei Hanayashiki, nicknamed "the Punching Ball", asks his clients to hit him. Thus, charged with their emotions, he goes out to solve his investigations with the force of his fists!

150739.description:
Jing Tao has been secretly in love with Lu Yi Zhou for ten years, but it's just so hard to make Lu get the hang of it! Just when Jing Tao was about to give up, Lu Yizhou started to woo him. "Wait! Didn't you see me as a brother?" "Just because we're close as brothers, I'm discussing with you about something deeper~"

(Source: Mangatoon)

150741.description:
Tao is a young master of the Yin and Yang way, a hermit with unprecedented powers. Naturally nonchalant, nothing can destabilize him except his untimely sleep attacks: narcoleptic, he sometimes falls asleep uncontrollably. This is why he needs the assistance of Ranran, a medium with a strong character, as beautiful as she is fearless. Together, they sell their services to the highest bidder in a changing modern China. Divination, enchantment and the conjuring of demons of all kinds are the daily life of these two experts in Fangshu, the art of the Taoist mages. One day, they leave the Celestial Mountains of the Tian Shan region to head for Hong Kong where a mission awaits them. But an unexpected encounter will push them to travel across the seas to Japan, where striking spirits, demons and divine creatures are legion and could use a good lesson.

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

150744.description:
Seventeen years ago, the world was saved from destruction by the Seven Heroes. But it came with the sacrifice of the strongest one among them, Seomun Yeop. Now that there is peace, beings like the Seven Heroes known as “espers” no longer have use for their supernatural powers. That’s where Battle Field comes in, an action VR game specifically created to allow espers to showcase their skills. Unfortunately, Korea hasn’t been doing so well in the recent tournaments, making it hard to believe that it was once home to the greatest esper in history. But just when all hope seems lost, Seomun Yeop miraculously returns! Will the legendary hero be able to save his people yet again?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: เกมของยอดมนุษย์

150745.description:
Fight for your survival, fight to escape the abandonment.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

150746.description:
After a failed attempt at ending her own life, our female lead is reborn in the body of a blood-sucking Vampire who is unable to die. To her dismay, she discovers that she is Luna, the Final Boss of the Novel, "The Hunter and the Saintess,", which she read before jumping to her death.

She realizes that her once chance at a clean death is the prolonged and painful end, destined for her at the hands of the novel's protagonists.

"Please, can't i just die in Peace?!!!" With centuries to go until the protagonists are even born, Luna launches a multi-generational master plan to change the course of the original story. If the protagonists are provided will all the tools and benefits they need, they could destroy her with ease, allowing her to end things in peace.

For centuries, Luna executes this master plan, only to have her own involvement interrupt her desired outcomes at each turn. With powerful abilities and the influence of noble houses at her fingertips, will Luna's plans to find and raise her fated killers succeed? Will she get the peaceful death she desires?

(Source: Pocket Comics, edited)

150747.description:
“Hi! My name is Minji Kim. I used to be a teenage girl but after waking up from a nap one day, I turned into a fugly lizard! I want to go home! Somebody help! Wait… but, if I'm in this strange body, who’s in mine?!”

Minji is a high school girl living a normal life in an ordinary world. After waking up from her usual nap in class one day, she discovers that she has transformed into a powerful dragon who lives in an out-of-the-ordinary land. Minji forms a group of eccentric friends by using her wits, and together they embark on a journey to help Minji find her way back to her own world. Will Minji ever be able to return home?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Rinha, Korea's most beloved actress, gets into an accident while on set. When she regains consciousness, she realizes she has traveled to the Kingdom of Iklein and meets the northern duke Calcion, who saves her from a demonic beast. Calcion asks her to be his fake lover so she can get into socialite and discover the conspiracy happening in his castle.

(Source: WEBTOON)

150751.description:
The story centers on Asahi Kashiwagi, a boy who runs into a series of unusual accidents one morning on the way to school — all in accordance with a vague fortune prediction he saw on TV that morning, which culminates with an unfortunate encounter with a girl. Coincidentally, all the people he meets are new students or teachers at his school. Asahi's prior knowledge of the girls earns him the suspicion of Yoshio, a self-proclaimed "friend of Asahi." After school, he finds a love letter in his shoe locker, telling him to come to the cherry blossom tree behind the school, again according to his morning fortune. Asahi heads to the cherry blossom tree to see what awaits him.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

150778.description:
Akira has absolutely no interest in being in a romantic relationship. As long as he can meet his sexual needs, he doesn't really care about bothersome things like love. So when an incubus (with wings and a pointy tail) approaches Akira with a proposal of just bodily relations, he accepts (maybe a bit too easily). Apparently, incubi view sex as humans view dinner. So... in a way, the incubus is simply just asking Akira to grab dinner with him. But how will the incubus take it when Akira asks the incubus to grab breakfast the next morning?

(Source: Futekiya)

150779.description:
Narumi Ebihara has lost the ability to say no to a job. It's not his fault, though! The shady company he used to work for conditioned him to overwork himself on a terribly low wage. But when that company goes under overnight, Narumi is left scrambling for new employment. Thanks to his luck (and frankly, his gullibility), Narumi lands a one-month trial period as a live-in manager for a promising new actor, Leo Uchiumi. If all goes well, Narumi will have a higher salary, nicer accommodation, and a rewarding job after a month! A new wind is blowing in Narumi's direction... but that's not the only thing blowing... Narumi Ebihara has lost the ability to say no to a job. To any job...

(Source: Manga Planet)

Toshiyuki proposes to Yuzuru to move to the apartment next to him once he gets out of the company's dorms so they'll be closer to each other. Yuzuru finds the idea appealing. Though, when a new crew member, Shoui Kouzu, enters the picture, what does it bode for the both of them?

150781.description:
Yu meets his friends almost every day in a game called Amalthea Online. He feels comfortable around them and especially admires his teammate Kirito. Kirito is the cool head of the team who leads everyone through battles and makes tough calls. Yu is the team's star mage who resurrects everybody when they're in a pinch. Wanting to meet Kirito offline, Yu decides to accept the team's invitation to meet up. Will they be expecting a pretty girl like Yu's character? More importantly, how will Kirito react to the real-life Yu? One thing leads to another, and that same night, Yu and Kirito are sharing the same bed?! Somebody is going to have to rez Yu IRL stat!

(Source: Futekiya)

150782.description:
Part 1 and Part 2
It has been ten years since Gai Kutani and Shougo Kanou's aviation school days. However, Kanou changed course and became a highly skilled flight attendant after a sudden falling out. It has been ten years, but neither of them has forgotten. Will an executive flight together help them reconcile? Or will it serve as the perfect runway for revenge?

Flight 1, Flight 2, and The Final Flight
Jun Mikimoto works at an airline company with his cousin, Rui, as his boss and his uncle as the airline's managing director. And when Rui is the literal poster boy for the airline, Jun has mixed feelings about whether he is really suited for this job. However, one day he is unexpectedly requested to attend the upcoming flight carrying the Executive Chief Cabinet Secretary. Did they accidentally mix him up with Rui or...?

Extras
Familiar faces from Secret Flight might make some appearances...!

TW: Rape

(Source: Futekiya)

A brand new profession was thus born, controlling various elements such as iron, copper, phosphorus, gold, silicon, and carbon, they are the strongest combat power in the world. Restarting a powerful system, the youth began to be accompanied by compulsive tasks again and again! Challenging missions full of danger time and time again, he gradually became stronger, and went further and further on the road to a great demon...

(Source: WebComics)

150784.description:
Yuuki is your average university student. He gets his heart worked up, attends mixers, and has a very specific insecurity about his body: he can lactate. He has not told a soul. He does not plan on telling a soul. But when his childhood friend Touma walks in on him in a compromising position, he has to come clean. How will Touma react when he learns his childhood friend has randomly unlocked the ability to lactate? Was it even totally random?...

(Source: Futekiya)

When the foolish but cute glutton Hua Manman transmigrated into a novel becoming a villainess, she was supposed to refuse the king’s hand in marriage to wash away his misfortune and then enter the Imperial Palace to become one of the Emperor’s concubines. Now considered persona non grata, Dumashion has only one goal: to prove his worth and regain control of his homeland. He will be aided in his quest by a handful of colourful allies, as well as by mech-armor, those super-powerful robots capable of decimating entire armies.

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

150787.description:
While trying to escape from the police during a car chase, a young criminal unwillingly makes a time jump and lands in 2050, in the city of Neo-Tokyo. But his journey has left him with total amnesia, and no sooner has he arrived than he is pursued not only by the police, but also by a large-scale criminal organization. They all suspect him of possessing supernatural powers, which he would have acquired during his crossing. To get out of this situation, the young man will have to agree to join the police and take on the role of Ryuu Urashima, alias Urashiman, the cop of the future.

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

150788.description:
While journalist Mike Donovan was filming soldiers in combat in El Salvador, huge UFOs (later called "mother ships") from the Sirius star system, 8.6 light years from the solar system, suddenly appeared in the sky in many places around the world. After making contact for the first time by radio transmission, following a countdown, they agree on a first direct contact with the UN Secretary General. The aliens appear to be human in form and declare that they have come in peace, gradually settling in among the population. They say they want to share their knowledge in exchange for terrestrial chemicals that are supposed to solve their environmental problems on the planet of their star system ("much more serious" than ours). But their real intentions are quite different...
In fact, the visitors are secretly pumping out all the water on Earth. Moreover, they are 'lizards' (also known as 'reptilians' or humanoid reptiles) who regard humans as food. So they want to fill their larder with millions of earthlings (among others). Little by little, a secret organisation of resistance fighters, led by Mike Donovan and Dr Julie Parrish, assisted by rebel visiting soldiers ("the Fifth Column"), is organised for a titanic battle. A battle that is far from won, as Diana, a high-ranking officer in the invaders' army, wants to subdue humanity completely at all costs.

(Source: Mangas.io, translated)

Jaesung and his father were living alone, barely making ends meet in a tiny apartment when they get the terrible news from Japan that Jaesung’s older brother died. According to Jaesung’s incredibly sexy Japanese sister-in-law, it was his brother’s final wish for her and her sister to move to Korea and live with their family. The girls move in and, while mildly uncomfortable, Jaesung is putting up with it. But one night he comes home late from work and hears strange moaning sounds coming from his father’s bedroom. After peaking in, he finds his father and his sister-in-law having sex! At first, he’s extremely disgusted, but Jaesung can’t get the thought of his sister-in-law’s naked body out of his mind. If only his sister-in-law would let him get a taste as well… after all, his brother’s gone and he’s much younger and fitter than his father.

Izumi, a high school teacher, playfully asks his student, Enomoto Ritsu, "Would you like to go out with me?" She resolves herself to put her memories behind her and adjust to working side-by-side with the living ghosts of her past. But, she realizes she's not the only one who remembers who they all used to be. Things only grow more complicated as office crushes are revealed, new members of the Kingdom of Eophilt appear around Seoul, and hiding their connection starts to bring up suspicions at work. Will Cheong-ha finally be freed from the mysteries of her past to live her best life in the present?

6. Himitsuteki Kousatsu (秘密的考察)
7. Ayako-Chan wa Hiroko-Senpai ni Koi Shiteru: Bangai-hen(彩香ちゃんは弘子先輩に恋してる 番外編)

150836.description:
Machiavelli and Gerrard are just one of the many names the new professor of Ceoren Academy uses to disguise his identity, and now he can add one more to his list, Professor Ludger Cherish. The real Ludger Cherish dies on board a train during a terrorist attack, making him the perfect target for a new identity. Little does the new professor know, Ludger Cherish was involved in something deep and secret. The new Professor Ludger has to be careful to not get caught by the school and the dangerous secret society.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I Got a Fake Job at the Academy

150837.description:
Yoshida Hana has only one goal in life: to find her soulmate.
Dreamy, distracted and hopeful, she wants to find someone to share those feelings with; no luck though. After several love affairs with no future, he does not lose sight of his ideal and share that desire with others. Therefore, he doesn't bother trying to convince his subordinate, Takada, that soul mates do exist and that he will find his own one day… Which Takada isn't really interested in, nor does he believe there is. In this unique senpai-subordinate relationship there is something that neither dares to say out loud, until one day they see each other outside of work at Takada's house. Pancakes and a hidden longing! What will happen between Hana and Takada on an unexpected night?

150838.description:
Kisaragi Manaka; a high-school student who, ever since giving up on his first love, had since avoided falling in love again. However, after discovering that he was living in the same apartment building as the classmate rumored to be of British descent, Hiiragi Stella—

“I can at least cook, you know! I’ll boil the water!”

—he found her image to be different from when she was at school and had a hard time leaving her alone.

Seeing her clumsiness, which resulted in her not being able to live a decent life by herself (in fact, she can’t even speak English), Manaka couldn’t just stand by and watch without doing anything, so he decided to look after her.

Sharing dinner with her on a daily basis, hanging out with her whenever she was lonely… They were almost living together before he knew it! However, Manaka had already made a decision not to fall in love again! “I won’t give up! Datte konna ni mo SU-SUKI nan desu kara!”

Stella, on the other hand, had already made up her resolve and approached Manaka head-on!? Dammit! What’s with this cute little creature!? You’re going to make my heart race, you know!
synonyms: The British Girl Wants To Say “Suki”, Not “I Love You”
She'd like to say not "I Love You" but "SUKI"
Eikoku Kanojo wa "Love You" Janakute "Suki" to Iitai
Eikoku Kanojo ha "Rabu Yuu" jyanakute "SUKI" to iitai

title.native: 英国カノジョは“らぶゆー”じゃなくてスキと言いたい
title.romaji: Eikoku Kanojo wa "Love You" ja Nakute Suki to Iitai

150839.description:
'Changsu' is a great start-up with the saying that the health center is the trend. However, the sales rise vertically when a deficit is lost due to the lack of sales, and an Albanian who has a sensual body! What is the secret of her suspicious business?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.native: 隣のおちんぽ♂お姉さん

150841.description:
My beloved giant-boobed girlfriend.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Aoha 2020 Aki

150842.description:
Running a brothel is a tough business. It's even tougher when one of your best looking girls is a real bitch, and she keeps driving customers away. As the head manager, I think it's time for a special lesson...

(Source: TOPTOON+)
synonyms: 箱ヘル～ビジネスからロマンスまで～

150843.description:
1. Yawahada (柔肌, Soft, Fair Skin); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 23
2. Yawahada: after (柔肌 after); Rakuen Web Zoukan 2017-03
3. Tanoshii Karada (たのしいからだ); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 24
4. Girlfriend: after (ガールフレンド after); Rakuen Web Zoukan 2016-12
5-6. Hasu no Hana (蓮の花, Lotus Flower); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 26-27
7. film; Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 28
8. Yoru wo Tomenaide: after 2 (夜をとめないで after2, Don't Stop the Night after 2); Rakuen Web Zoukan 2018-12
9. Itohoshi (いとほし, Pitiful); Rakuen Le Paradis Vol. 29

150845.description: Sparkling love is not the only kind there is. Keita is a high school student who likes his friend Masato. However, his love could not be more different from the sort of sparkling love often seen in BL... This is a delicate, bittersweet story of adolescence.

title.native: キラキラしても、しなくても

150847.description: Da-Hye was forced to grow up in a cult by her mother, cut off from the rest of the world. However, she meets a half-sister her age named Yun-Seo, who is her polar opposite, and meets new people.

150849.description: Kagaishi, who was transferred to an unfamiliar sales position after only six months in the company, is struggling at his job. The one person who always treats him kindly is his co-worker in the sales department, Hiyou. She is the complete opposite of Kagaishi-kun, a sparkling girl who is beautiful, a strong communicator, and good at her job. However, like a resident of another world, Hiyou-san has an unbelievable hobby that she can't tell anyone about...

title.native: 別世界のキラキラ同期がエッチなイラストを描いている
title.romaji: Bessekai no Kirakira Douki ga Ecchi na Illustration wo Kaite iru

150850.description:
Zhao Jingyu never thought he'd be reborn, and that his fiancee is the princess who will eventually become an usurper and a tyrannical empress. He did everything he could to try to steer her life away from going down that path of evil. But it turned out that she didn't care about politics in this life at all, she just wanted to spend all her time with him? That's fine, they'll just make some babies, and she'll be too busy taking care of the kids to plan any coups. Sounds like a plan!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: The Lady Is The Future Tyrant
My Wife is Actually the Future Tyrant Empress

title.native: 娘子竟是未来暴君女帝
title.romaji: Niangzi Jing Shi Weilai Baojun Nüdi

150852.description:
The most average, every day moment in the world of comic publishing: a comic artist having a meeting with her editor. It's hard to believe that one day can change all of that forever.

The world has ended.

The few humans who managed to survive fight bitterly over foodscraps --- or not...?

An apocalyptic essay about the every day lives of the people who work in the manga industry after the world has ended.

All the ideas they come up with for a new comic have, generally speaking, already been done.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: Cartoonists and Editors After the End of the World

title.english: A Cartoonist and Her Editor at the End of the World
title.native: 世界が終わったあとの漫画家と編集者
title.romaji: Sekai ga Owatta Ato no Mangaka to Henshuusha

150853.description: Hachigata Natsuhiko tries to summon a Succubus, but instead his roommate gets turned into one!
synonyms: A New Living Arrangement With My Friend ♂ Turned Succubus

title.native: 同居人（♂）がサキュバスになっちゃった話
title.romaji: Doukyonin (♂) ga Succubus ni Nacchatta Hanashi

title.native: 邪神戦線リストラ・ボーイ

150855.description:
Nao Minase's coworker, Chiaki Ookawa, has a strong personality, eye-catching good looks, and secures tons of contracts because of that. It's no wonder Nao sees him as a rival, but he's also in love with him. Ever since entering the company, the two of them have had the same assignments, and their competitive personalities and constant rivalry has made people treat them like a pair. Beyond their stubbornness lies a (supposed) fondness for each other, but they're stuck in the limbo of unrequited feelings?all because they refuse to proclaim their feelings first! On the brink of that battle, a business trip sends the two men to a hotel, where love can't help but run amok!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

150856.description:
Mashiba's one reprieve from overwork is buying jewel-like chocolate from a shop he once found by chance. After a long stretch of going without his sweet treat, work finally gives him time to stop by. However, the shop closes right before he arrives, leaving him dejected. Thanks to prince-like chocolatier Minemura's kindness, however, Mashiba receives the opportunity to taste test new products. The sweet taste of chocolate and kindness makes him cry. Anyone would blush from the combination of sweet treats, a kind, handsome man, and a warm, consoling hand to rub their back. But, one day, Minemura makes things physical when the two of them leave his shop...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: スイート・ビター・スイート

150857.description:
An unforgettable memory for Shinobu Ichijou, an employee at a sports company... That is, doing naughty stuff with the high school friend he secretly looked up to. He wants to forget about it, but he even dreams of it and goes to work feeling frustrated.
There, he learns that Soichiro Mikado, a professional baseball player, will be appearing in his company's new commercial! Shinobu can't seem to rejoice at the sight of this star right before his very eyes. That's because Soichiro's... the high school friend he can't get over...!!

Shinobu wants to support him simply as a fan, but his body can't help but lust for him! This is a reunion love comedy between two high school friends.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 拗らせくんはファンでいたい

150858.description:
On the surface, Sudou looks like your average deliveryman—but the truth is that he’s a courier for a shady underground transport service where no job is off-limits. One day, bonding with his standoffish neighbor Uno leads to the two sleeping side by side, and Sudou develops feelings a miscreant like him doesn’t deserve to experience… But when he later finds Uno caught in a street fight and gets hurt trying to save him, he learns Uno’s hiding a supernatural secret that will change Sudou’s life forever!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

150859.description:
Liu Mo went through ten years of strenuous cultivation until he formed an infant immortal body, and only then was he ready to leave the mountain and head out into the mortal world. But... "I only just formed an immortal body at 18, but there are people who have already ascended to heaven by age 8. I must not have much talent at cultivation!"

"This world seems awfully scary, there are powerful folks everywhere..."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150860.description:
"I can't accept a confession from my stepsister." He thought he'd refused her forcefully enough! But now through circumstance they'll have to live together under the same roof???

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150861.description:
Magical girls- guardians of the people, vanquishers of witches, and defenders of the innocent, all while putting smiles on the faces of children in a flashy spectacle of mass-marketable entertainment. However, things aren't always so family friendly behind the scenes! When the villains get too gruesome for Saturday morning cartoons, these youthful protectors are, in turn, protected by...grizzled middle-aged men? They may be a bunch of old farts, but these geezers have one job: to use their wealth of experience (and some kick-ass magic) to support the mystical maidens from the shadows!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

150862.description:
Seemingly-innocent-but-actually-calculating boy vs. cold straight guy

Bai Jinyi knows perfectly well that as a typical straight guy, Zhang Zucong cannot tell good girls from cunning ones. As a matter of fact, he loves girls who look harmless but fake. To win Zhang Zucong's love, Bai Jinyi has to hide his true self and pretend to be one of those girls...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Adapted from the web novel Ni Zaibu Wan Wo Jiu Hei Huale (你再不弯我就黑化了).

title.english: If You Continue to Ignore Me, I'll Turn Into A Villain
title.native: 你再不理我，我就黑化了
title.romaji: Ni Zaibu Li Wo, Wo Jiu Hei Huale

150863.description:
Lin Jing was your average model student: serious, diligent and polite. However, after transferring to a new school for his sophomore year, his life took a sudden turn when he was forced to become a minion for the bottom-ranked delinquent.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150864.description: The second-year high school girl Hinano has a crush on a senior who already had a girlfriend. When she complained about it to her younger childhood friend Sei, he suddenly asked her, "Why not me?" A love story between a single-minded junior boy and a timid older girl!
synonyms: Sei-kun wa Kyou mo Sukina no ni

title.native: 聖くんは今日も好きなのに
title.romaji: Sei-kun wa Kyou mo Sukina noni

150865.description:
Selene was fortunate to be born to her beloved mother not just once, but twice. And now that her single mother has died in her second life, Selene must face the world as an orphan... or so she thought. Before she knows it, she's swept up by a handsome stranger who turns out to be her father and the nation's emperor! Not only that, but she discovers she has three older brothers who absolutely adore her. Going from the slums to the imperial palace overnight isn't easy, however, and Selene must navigate her family dynamics, the rules of the palace, and the unbearable loneliness of missing her mother. Moreover, Selene begins to realize that there's a hidden reason why she remembers her past life so well. Will Selene be able to find closure from her past and finally mend the hole that her mother's death left in her heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Was Born as the Second Daughter
เกิดอีกครั้งก็ยังเป็นลูกแม่
第二次作为女儿诞生了

150866.description:
When veterinarian Yoohee Han dies early, a grim reaper sends her into the world of a novel she once read to live out the rest of her time as the side character Alexa. She uses her knowledge of the novel (and of animals) to take on a more prominent role as the trainer of Isildus, heir of Terrecion, a wolf shifter who will remain in animal form until his 16th birthday. She becomes a beloved advisor in Terrecion castle, and her actions change the fates of other characters. How will little Issy feel about her when he becomes human?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 黒幕たちの調教師になりました

150867.description:
The distance between them is two bookshelves. This is a back-to-back love comedy.

Sakura is reputed to be the best looking boy in school, and Saionji is a beautiful girl who is reputed to be the reincarnation of an angel. Despite their appearance, they both have shy personalities. One day, they go to the library to take a break and start interacting with each other without knowing each other's faces.

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, an epilogue and an after story.

title.native: ネクラとヒリアが出会う時
title.romaji: Nekura to Hiria ga Deau Toki

150868.description:
Lu Wen, an eighteenth-tier actor, is handsome, hot, and has a natural flair for acting. However, he has low EQ and lacks the ability to make discerning judgments. On his first day of joining the production crew, he accidentally offends Qu Yanting, the most famous screenwriter in the industry. Later on, he thinks the latter is exacting revenge on him through his position, sponsoring a young male actor, and working on a silly web drama for the sake of money. Watch him slowly change his tune about Qu Yanting over time!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150869.description:
An accident during the time-travel process sent him back to the Damo Dynasty, into the body of an imprisoned duke accused of treason! Wait, why's the eunuch treating me like a love rival? And the emperor just wants to seduce me... Help, I want to go back!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150870.description:
The story of the cold young master and the boy his family adopted, Ji Bie.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150871.description:
Monsters roamed the land, ghost rose out of the ground, and the people were destitute and desperate. To deal with these spirits, the emperor appointed official "exorcists." They traveled all over to dispel the evil spirits in unique ways. As night falls and the bells toll, they will guard the ghost fire until it fades.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150872.description:
Xue Yang auctions his sketchbook off online to purchase his younger sister’s favorite idol, Ji Jiayu’s concert tickets. The buyer later discovers a love letter that Xue Yang had forgotten in his sketchbook. Little did he know, the buyer is Ji Jiayu, and the two of them get closer and closer in the anonymity of the internet...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150873.description:
A car accident transported Bai Zi'an into the world of "The Ruler of the Empire," an interstellar novel. There, System 66 told him that, in order to return to reality, he would have to play a dumb villain who frequently gets crushed by the novel's main character. Bai Zi'an is supposed to be cannon fodder, but somehow the Prince, the General, and even the main character are all falling over themselves just to woo him. Unbeknownst to him, Bai Zi'an is becoming a beloved character in the novel's world.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Fanpai Ta Bei Po Dang Tuan Chong

150874.description:
She is the most menial ugly daughter of a medical family, while he is the noblest prince in Kingdom Tianning. On their wedding day, when the bridal sedan chair reaches the Prince's mansion, the door is shut, she has no choice but to enter the mansion alone. Unexpectedly, the ugly girl is actually a gorgeous genius medic! Accidentally, she saves an assassin on her wedding night and promises him: Bro, hurry and leave, I won't get you exposed. However, the assassin says: it's our wedding night, where do you want me to go?

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 天才小毒妃之芸汐传奇
title.romaji: Tiancai Xiao Du Fei Zhi Yun Xi Chuanqi

150875.description:

150878.description:

2. Himitsu no Sensei (秘密の先生); Comic Megastore Alpha 2014-08
3. Segashira-san no Kyuujitsu (瀬頭さんの休日); Comic Megastore Alpha 2014-09
4. Kamawaretagari (かまわれたがり); Comic Megastore Alpha 2015-03
5. Oshiriasobi (おしりあそび); Comic Megastore Alpha 2016-03

150879.description:
The Crown Prince Wilhelm suddenly announced the dissolvement of his betrothal to Constance (Connie), the daughter of a marquis. It seems like he had fallen in love with someone else... a saint who had appeared recently. Connie grew depressed at the cruel declaration, as she had spent the past two years acting as his consort. But one day, her memory returned, and she realized that she had been reincarnated as the villainess in a romance novel.

"Whatever. I don't need a cheater (with the option to become a villainess). I'll live on as the leader of my land!"

This is Connie's story of how she lives her life with strength in the borderlands far away from the capital city!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: 慘遭退婚的反派千金轉身為荒野當家。
ชีวิตสโลว์ไลฟ์ในดินแดนรกร้างของคุณหนูตัวร้าย
La villaine méprisée survit malgré tout

title.english: The Scorned Villainess Survives in the Wilderness
title.native: 婚約を破棄された悪役令嬢は荒野に生きる。
title.romaji: Konyaku wo Hakisareta Akuyaku Reijou wa Kouya ni Ikiru.

title.native: K子と病みおじ・番外編

150881.description: You should always be careful when making a high school debut, especially around the quiet girl from your middle school...
synonyms: The Untold Story of a High School Debut

title.native: 高校デビューができない話

synonyms: You're the One Who Taught Me

title.native: 教えたのそっちじゃん

150886.description:
From encounters with cats to bookstore trips and every sweet moment in between, enjoy this anthology exploring Sasaki’s and Miyano’s relationship together—including three original stories by Shou Harusono!

(Source: Yen Press)

Cover illustration: Harusono Shou
Illustrations: Harusono Shou, Nazuka Kudan, Kanzume Sawa
