synonyms: Sasaki and Miyano Official Anthology Comic

title.english: Sasaki and Miyano Official Comic Anthology
title.native: 佐々木と宮野 公式アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Sasaki to Miyano: Koushiki Anthology Comic

150887.description: Will, a boy who can use healing magic, escapes a research facility with his older sister. Together they travel this broken world to unravel the secrets of his origin.

150888.description:
Ever since he was a student, Fukawa has always been told by everyone about how "normal" he is. He was just a temporary staff working hard to become a full-time employee when Subada, the company's ace suddenly called out to him with an offer, "I'm going to go independent to start my own company and I'd like you to join me".

Though the offer surprised him, Fukawa decided to work for Subada in order to make a change for himself. However, Subada turned out to be a "special" person who has an abnormal affinity to be liked by just about anyone! His life used to be ordinary but as he comes to learn of Subada's many different sides, Fukawa now finds that not only his lifestyle but also his feelings are beginning to change...

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

150890.description:
When I was younger, one of my best friends was Kyouko. She was a brash and hotheaded young girl who, even though she was a tomboy, was still loved by her peers.

To be honest, it’s been a few years since I came back home. The only person I know from there was Kyouko and she seems… different?

Notes:
- The manga was licensed by Kadokawa and released as a single volume on November 22, 2023.
- R18 extras are published on the author's Pixiv Fanbox account.
synonyms: When I Returned to My Hometown, My Childhood Friend Was Broken

title.native: 地元に帰ってきたら幼馴染が壊れてた
title.romaji: Jimoto ni Kaettekitara Osananajimi ga Kowareteta

150892.description:
One day, Azuma Kanon saw a girl fall from the sky. This encounter with a new friend will change her daily life into one full of "kisses"... A sweet, sour, passionate girls-love romantic comedy full of "kisses" has begun!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)
synonyms: After Kissing Many Girls, I Became A Yuri Kisser...
Ironna Onnanoko to Kisu o shiteitara, Yuri Kisu ni Mezamete shimaimashita…

title.native: 色んな女の子とキスをしていたら、百合キスに目覚めてしまいました…。
title.romaji: Ironna Onnanoko to Kiss wo Shiteitara, Yuri Kiss ni Mezamete Shimaimashita....

150894.description:
"Even if all I can use is basic healing magic, I'll still become the strongest!"

A Level 1 healer boy and the weakest divinely chosen girl set out on a journey with the goal of becoming the strongest. However, the boy never imagined that this journey would be the last one of his life.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150896.description:
After the "Metaverse" incident, spiritual aura became the new reality, as monsters roamed the land, and humans were forced to stay within fortified cities to survive. Scientists developed a game called "Heavenly Palace," designed to collect spiritual power from its players and convert it into energy. Since then society was reorganized to allow everyone to play the game. But is Heavenly Palace really humanity's salvation? When Xiao Ce accidentally triggered the Zhuque System, connecting the game world to reality, he was able to freely travel between them. This allowed him to see the truth behind Heavenly Palace…

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: 最底辺プレイヤーの爆速最強リベンジ

150897.description:
“We shall fight till there's only one of us left standing!”

"Have you ever experienced the feeling of being pushed into the abyss by the love of your life? " Nangong Yue was from a famous and noble famous in her previous life. She was an excellent doctor. She helped him ascend to the throne but in turn, her family was slaughtered at his orders. The first-born daughter is back and she's coming back to get even! I thought I wouldn't let anyone in my heart again. But a man changed everything...

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: Spoiled Medical Princess: The Legend of Alkaid

title.english: Spoiled Medical Princess - Legend of Yaoguang
title.romaji: Sheng Chong Yi Fei Zhi Yao Guang Zhuan

150898.description:
I, Gu Shaoyang, have the ability to extract and fuse other people's attributes. Extracting the foundational talents from geniuses, I instantly became the most fearsome cultivator in the world. Fusing cheap stones and useless potions, I can create priceless gems and godly elixirs. Now I just want to know: when will I be invincible?!!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150899.description:
When our protagonist fainted after being hit in the head, he transmigrated into dream-land. Thus started his new life of working in our world during the day, and saving the other world at night.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zhi Shi Ge Pingfan Ren

150900.description:
The overworked programmer Qin Jian suddenly died after working non-stop for several days. His soul transmigrated into the body of a provincial official in the Tianyuan Dynasty. He thought he find himself a pretty wife and enjoy life in the official mansion. But it turned out he was given the Heaven's Eye ability, which allowed him to see demons and other spirits. In fact, he's been sleeping with a major demon the whole time, which made everyone think he's a dangerous demon, too. Now he has to live with all sorts of demons, as he starts on a fantastic journey of demonic cultivation.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

150901.description:
The world is facing the attack of beasts, and all mankind awakens extraordinary power by believing in the blessings of gods. When Ye Bei was laughed at for not being an Awakener, no one knew that the whole world was just an online game for him, and he was the only player!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Age of the Gods: The World Becomes an Online Game

title.native: 神明时代：世界变成了网游

150902.description:
When a terrible disaster struck their school, Zong Luofeng was out sick and avoided the worst. But his best friend Lu Yun and secret crush Chen Yao both died in the incident. He was feeling down on himself when he was suddenly pulled into a time loop! Returned to the time before the tragedy, seeing everyone alive again… can he change the ending this time?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.native: 劇画 魔の三角海域

150904.description:
The young man Torres had wanted to become a paladin all his life. Now he was on his way to his final trial before graduation: return to his home town to capture a former soldier turned serial-killer. But halfway there, he was attacked by Lian Yue, a warrior from the Far East!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: 劇画 日本の宇宙人

150907.description:
Alto is the hard-working butler for Wendy, a very selfish young lady. Finally, he collapses from overwork and is forced to leave the mansion. Lost on the street, he meets Uruk, the feared "Lady of the Ice". This is an isekai fantasy where the main character makes full use of the "original magic" he developed through his butler skills!

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)
synonyms: The World’s Strongest Butler: I Was Banished From the Black Workplace, and I Was Picked Up by an Ice Lady

title.native: 【世界最強の執事】ブラック職場を追放された俺、氷の令嬢に拾われる
title.romaji: [Sekai Saikyou no Shitsuji] Black Shokuba wo Tsuihou Sareta Ore, Kouri no Reijou ni Hirowareru

150908.description:
A thousand years ago, the world was in confusion and kingdoms at war. An apprentice at the Immortal Jade Pavilion died mysteriously, drained of all of his life essence. Immortal Jade accused the demonic Hehuan Sect of the crime. When Bai Qiu learned of the incident, he went undercover into Hehuan Sect looking to uncover the truth, where he met Su Xiangxue, a Hehuan apprentice. The same strange power put Su Xiangxue on the verge of death. Whoever was behind this must be trying to control both the Taoist and Demonic sects! How will Bai Qiu solve the mystery and save his future wife?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: 道魔—炼气练了三千年外传
title.romaji: Dao Mo: Lian Qi Lianle Sanqian Nian Waizhuan

150911.description:
The hard-working game-player Feng Xia was ambushed and fell through a dimensional rift into another world, again. But in this new world he ran into "them" from the Xuanyuan World "by accident," too? Huh, why have the girls been turned into classmate, CEO, idol, delinquent, and chef? I have to seduce all of them to get back? And I can gain attributes for each one I seduce? What are we waiting for, then? Come on, ladies!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: 属性番外之我捡起了一地妹子
title.romaji: Shuxing Fanwai Zhi Wo Jian Qi Le Yi Di Meizi

150912.description: A corporate manager, reassigned to a subsidiary to save face after an employee scandal, is offered reinstatement to the main office in an unexpected way...

150913.description:
Revolutionary Threesome! I want beauties to attack me! ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2017-06

150916.description:
Chinese-style fantasy suspense! After experiencing a mining disaster conspiracy and a natural disaster, he was reborn!

Muscular zombie x dark-skinned wizard is amazing!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150917.description:
One is a beautiful chef with supreme talent in cooking who can recognise all kinds of herbs and meats and has extremely sharp senses except vision, while the other is a young man from an aristocratic family with great martial arts skills but great ambitions that cannot be realized. The two of them meet over food, and start a fantasy life working together to solve conspiracies.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: 劇画 失われたムー大陸

150920.description:
This is a world dominated by women, where heaven, earth, humans, gods, demons, and monsters coexist in the five realms. A thousand years ago, the suppressed demon race escaped into the world, causing widespread suffering. Qian Xiao, as the leader of all living beings, revived using Zhen Ling's flesh and blood to subdue the evil spirits. At the same time, he must abide by the taboos of not killing, not interfering, and not developing emotions...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150922.description:
The male protagonist was just an invisible nobody working in a state-owned enterprise. He certainly did not want to be forced by his mother to go on a blind date at the park on his very own birthday! ...Wait a minute, is this big scary thug also here for a blind date? Not only did the thug mistakenly eat the male protagonist's cookies, but they somehow magically cured his incurable disease too?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Buyao Chi Diao Wo De Xiao Binggan

150923.description:
Helping the boss survive tribulations also meant being his wife. After transmigrating through three lifetimes, they finally achieved a happy ending and returned home together.

The male lead is a yandere – a truly ill yandere, sick to the extreme and spoiled beyond compare.

Trigger Warning: In the protagonist's first life, they are a large-chested loli. Please read with caution if this is not acceptable.

(Wait a minute) – Even trigger points can become endearing points!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150925.description:
Hundreds of miles of mountains and rivers are destroyed, and thousands of years of history are burned. Why should the greedy wolf swallow the sun and the moon, and bury the lonely mountain without rewarding the hero? Long regret for the flower. Dripping water chisels through the stone wall, and the strong pine covered with snow welcomes spring. A little spark will set the whole world on fire, and there will be saints and sages who will pass on the torch for generations. Dare to be the first in the world.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150926.description:
The popular idol, He Ju, has a crush on the president of his management company, Zhao Zhiang. They accidentally swap bodies when Zhao Zhiang rejects He Ju's advances. Zhao Zhiang is left with no other option but to brace himself for show business. They can temporarily switch back, but only through a kiss. Until the problem is resolved, they are bound at the hip. Upon investigation, they find that someone coveting He Ju's fame and status is behind it all. There is something really fishing going on...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150927.description:
Just as Wu Xie thought he would finally have some peace and quiet, Jin Wantang visited and broke a news: Jin Wantang discovered the association between the scorpion engraving on the Moonstone and young ‘Wallflower’. Determined to get to the bottom of this, Wu Xie set off to Nepal and then landed in Metok—where he learned more and more about Wallflower. Later, he obtained Wallflower’s notebook from a lama in Jila Monastery which revealed the story behind Wallflower’s visit to the snow mountain. But what shocked Wu Xie more was the mention of ‘World’s Limit’ in the notebook and realization of another bronze gate amidst the snow mountain. Was there a reason why people from all walks of life gathered at Jila Monastery—was it coincidence or planned? What was the meaning behind the mysterious scorpion? What was the meaning of ‘World’s Limit’? Why was Wu Xie the only savior of the Zhang family? Were the Zhang’s trustworthy—were they answering a calling or conspiring against someone? A whole new journey awaits. Together with Fatty, Wu Xie trailed Wallflower’s footsteps into the snow mountain. Will Wu Xie’s question be answered in this adventure?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150928.description:
Jinha is an Omega with an Alpha phobia and Tae-Oh is his boyfriend who hasn't awakened yet. Tae-Oh has tried many methods to awaken his Alpha traits, but something inside him is preventing it. While Jinha tries to be strong for Tae-Oh, shady figures lurk to take advantage of his phobia.

(Source: INKR)

150929.description:
Waking up in a freezing capsule, the cartoonist Xiao Tong finds that he's entered a new era 300 years later when human beings coexist peacefully with many bloodline-awakened clans. The Vampire Actor Caesar is somehow attracted by the landfill worker Xiao Tong and even can't help marking him when they first encounter. A human being who gets marked by the blood clan will become the blood clan bride. In the confrontation between vampires and humans, two people from different eras gradually get closer to each other.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 成为吸血鬼影帝的新娘

150931.description:
An ordinary surgeon accidentally gained a powerful System. Now he will shock the medical world with his miraculous hands, saving countless lives.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150941.description:
“I wish we could go back to being friends, but I want to get closer than that.”

Hayakawa Akira, a third-year high school student, changes seats and sits next to his childhood friend Kuno Sumiya. Akira, who has many friends and is active, and Sumiya, who likes astronomy and is quiet. The two grew up in the house next door from an early age and were best friends despite their opposite personalities. However, when they were in elementary school, they had a trivial quarrel, and couldn’t say “I’m sorry” to each other, so they became estranged.

Akira feels awkward to start preparing for the school festival in the same group, Sumiya treats him kindly as before…

title.native: すんで、みつけて、きらめいて

150942.description:
Even if we're both betas and even if we're not a fated pair, it'll be fine. Our relationship won't change, ever.

Hibiki is a salaryman who has been living together with his high school sweetheart, Koushiro, for 10 years. When they had just met each other, they were convinced that they were a fated pair, but their gender tests revealed that they were both beta. Even though other gay couples can be blessed if they are a "fated pair," it vexes them they can't even hold hands in front of people. They tell themselves that if they love each other, all will be fine, but trivial things make them more anxious each day... But they hear about a misdiagnosis of the gender test one day...!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 君と運命についての話がしたい
title.romaji: Kimi to Unmei ni Tsuite no Hanashi ga Shitai

150946.description:
In her previous life, she was a palace insider, the consort of the fifth prince, famed for her haughty beauty. But overnight, her whole family was slain by order of the Emperor. As she died with hate in her heart, she was reincarnated as the daughter of the Shen clan, the ruler of the northwestern territory. Now she will use her cheat-like knowledge and looks to scheme and charm her way to the top! She is noble, beautiful, and cold, as she looked down on all before her. Nothing and no one will touch her heart in this life.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Hua Kai Hou Bai Hua Sha

150948.description:
Gu Ann, an artificial intelligence robot, is capable of travelling between virtual worlds. Her job is to avenge hosts and crack whoever fails them. She talks little, but moves ferociously. Whatever you scums obtain regardless of moral and manner, I will crash them with the flick of a finger.

(Source: Mangatoon)

150949.description:
Harassing bosses, useless coworkers, annoying customers, religious solicitors, troublesome men… These "horror stories" from daily life will be the side dish for two office ladies as they have dinner and a few drinks after work! Enjoy the "girls' night out" talk that will make you nod your head and say "ah-ha" as they savor Niigata's finest sake and cuisine.

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)
synonyms: As a snack, a story that doesn't look fashionable

title.native: 洒落にならない話をおつまみに

150951.description:
I lost my brother in a different galaxy, and I need help finding him... There's only one that can help me, but he's a total jerk!

(Source: Toomics)

title.romaji: Wanmei Lianren Zhi Moshi Shaojiang Qiu Fangguo

150952.description:
For love, Xia Ruoshui followed her boy friend to the Magic Capital and found an apartment on No. 44 West Street. In the same building lived a girl Luo Zheng and her strange mother Lü Luo. Luo Zheng was known as "The Reaper", because the rumors said that anyone who came in contact with her would mysteriously disappear. Xia Ruoshui got caught up in a lovers dispute and was badly hurt, but Luo Zheng was there and infused her own blood into Xia Ruoshui to save her from death...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extras chapters and 4 side-story chapters.

150953.description:
In school and in the workplace, Xue Momo was always at the center of attention, as she took down bad men and tore up lying women. Now she's set her sights on that stone-cold thousand-year old vampire CEO...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150955.description:
Naoto Kiba was born from the womb of a woman killed during a home robbery in the chaotic postwar period. As an orphan, Naoto lived a miserable childhood. He was treated like a mad dog, until he was introduced to karate, and the story depicted his growth both mentally and physically.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated)

150956.description:
While live-streaming a game, I played along when my partner joked about us being gay. All of a sudden, some hater and his ten alt accounts all started flaming my chat room. Then I found out that the homophobic hater was actually my roommate. When other people play games, they have to risk being shot to pick up gear. But when I play, three sugar daddies give me more gear than I can use, and get mad when I don't accept.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150971.description:
Xia Shicheng dressed up as a guy to join the boy band Zebra, which became an overnight sensation right away. The new group's popularity even overshadowed the established star Gu Lan. As the boy band seemed well on their way towards stardom, Xia Shicheng found herself targeted by Gu Lan, as her true identity teetered on the edge of exposure…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150974.description:
Nagisa, a web editor, has a crush on her boss, Inukai. One day, on the way home from a drinking party, Inukai suddenly tells her he loves her and wants to go out with her! Immediately after, a certain magic love charm activates, making Nagisa believe Inukai's confession wasn't real. Even though she tries to keep him at bay, he's feeling the anxiety of trying to convince her of his sincerity. Will things turn in the direction of sweet and affectionate love? A love story that blossoms from initial misunderstanding.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: 이누카이 씨는 오늘 밤 참지 않아!

150982.description:
A fantastical slice-of-life story about all the birds from Chinese legend, living as humans in the modern day.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150983.description:
The story revolves around the lives of eight current college students. Their different personalities and interests represent a microcosm of life on the modern college campus. They couldn't imagine that four years of college life together will also expose their personality flaws, as they find themselves through their daily interactions.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

150984.description:
Due to urbanization and warfare, the places where humans once lived had turned into deserts. When Martin–a young researcher–and his team were exploring the desert, they were ambushed by a huge monster and he was separated from his team. Fortunately, he was rescued by a mysterious centaur, who then protected him as he found his way back. Eventually, Martin discovered the secret of centaurs and world transmutation. None of them seems coincidental…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

150985.description:
Two roommates who are total opposites turn out to be married to each other inside a video game! Now they are stuck with each other inside the game. How will they get out of this relationship and get back to the real world?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Shi You Hao Qiguai

150986.description:
You Qiuzi's name was one that everyone in her school has heard of. With barely any friends because of her thick makeup and redoubtable presence, hardly anyone dared to approach her. But beneath her intimidating exterior was a hurt and broken soul that just couldn't relate to anyone, let alone making friends with strangers. Until one day, when her boring life was changed by her reunion with her childhood friend Gao Tuo after five years. Facing someone who felt so familiar and yet so distant at the same time, before she even knew it, she found herself trying to scale the extra mile just to see him smile...

(Source: Webnovel)

150987.description:
Born to a family of forensicists, the college senior Song Ziyang was in class when he met the police investigator Tang Youyou. From there they will encounter a series of horrifying supernatural cases. Dead infants, haunted cars, mutilated bodies… each case testing the limits of human sanity, but each with a unique story to tell.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150988.description:
To get help to find his mother, Yanxia agreed to a strange condition set by his estranged brother Siyue: Yanxia has to pretend to be Siyue and take his place for a year at Tiancheng College, the most exclusive private school in the city. But from the first day of class, Yanxia realized that the entire school was filled with Siyue's messy relationships! Taking on his brother's esteemed nickname of "Hardcore Playboy," Yanxia not only has to deal with crazed female fans, but a bunch of weird guys, too!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

150989.description:
Adapted from the otome game of the same name. Yue Feixi transmigrated into a mad world where human greed and desire are magnified. When humanity has lost its light, can we find a way in the dark? See how Feixi will navigate the Nanchao continent, in a courageous adventure filled with love and betrayal, promises and lies, despair and hope.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes prologue chapter.

150990.description:
What should I do if my sweet childhood friend became a simp? An Weilin, a recently promoted priest, ran upon Chi Xiao, one of his boyhood buddies he hadn't seen in years, during the shapeshifter hunting operation. He had no idea that his childhood pal had turned into the subordinate of his Family's Murder! What's worse, Chi Xiao had gone from sweet and gentle to strong and paranoid! An Weilin had to cope with Chi Xiao who had changed drastically while looking for the truth about his parents's murder. What he didn't expect was that all the clues would lead back to himself!!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.
